They provide high-level abstraction by representing structural and behavioral properties of software system and represents multiple views addressing the needs of diverse stakeholders of business organizations. This paper is an attempt to share our long-stint industry and research experiences, and best practices — that were gathered through multi-continent MNCs, various domains, tools and technologies — as a roadmap for building an effective complex enterprise architecture in this current day digital transformation era which is technology agnostic. It defines various types of architectures that are applicable in software systems design which address various problems within the context of customer and system requirements.

articleTitle: Blockchain based remittances and mining using CUDA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A large number of people earn money in foreign countries and many of them have to send across the money back home in India. For every such transaction, multiple fees could be charged, varying from 3 to 12 percent. In this paper we offer a peer-to-peer settlement solution for such remittance on blockchain at negligible rates. Money transfers can be securely converted into crypto-currencies, which can easily be transferred across nations, and then again converted into local currencies. In this paper, we use Multi-chain for digital assets and peer-to-peer electronic cash systems where transactions take place between users directly, without an intermediary. These transactions are verified by network nodes and recorded in a public distributed ledger called the blockchain. Each block is verified and added to the blockchain (distributed public ledger), which includes all past transactions through a process known as Mining. Mining using CPU is unwise and has high cost of operation. We present an alternative approach using CUDA-enabled Graphics Processing Unit(GPU) for mining. The massively parallel nature of some GPUs majorly increases the mining power.

articleTitle: Low power ASIC implementation of signed and unsigned wallace-tree with vedic multiplier using compressors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Multiplier is an important block in most of the digital signal processor (DSP) and high performance systems. The performance of such systems can be improved by implementing high speed multiplier. In this research work new modified compressor based multiplier architecture is introduced. This structure uses the 3-2, 4-2, 5-2 and 7-2 compressors architecture which has less area compare to normal adders. The comparison was made on synthesis results of all other adder, comparison shows that the new introduced adders consume less area and power. In addition to that it uses Vedic multiplier and unsigned Baugh-wooley Wallace tree multiplier to increase the performance of multiplier with less area and power. The ASIC Implementation can be done using Cadence 45nm CMOS technology. Further optimization can be done using other physical design optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: A effective communication solution for the hearing impaired persons: A novel approach using gesture and sentence formation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: People who are not able to speak and hear are considered to be disabled people. Such people use Sign Language as their communication medium. Sign Language use hand gesture instead of speech sounds for communication. But it is difficult for normal people to understand sign language. Recently, many of the sign language recognition systems were developed but they lacked in providing proper communication medium. This paper overcomes these problems. Hence this paper aims at converting the human sign language into text and voice form and also to learn sign language and provide translation of sign language in written text for people and convert that into voice form. Additionally it provides an option for the normal people to enter the input in the form of text and the system converts into sign language images and in video form. This system helps both the normal and hearing impaired people to have effective communication with each other.

articleTitle: Grid interactive rooftop solar PV power plant for educational institute
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Coal fired power plants are the backbone of In India power sector that forms about 59% of total installed capacity. The energy generation through coal route produces CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission that forms about 0.2 million tonne per hour. Moreover, the coal is a finite source of energy which may exhaust and is non renewable. On the other hand, in Indian power scenario, due to huge gap between power supply and demand, the power cuts are being faced frequently that force the use to diesel generator set whose cost of generation is very high as well as foreign exchange is involved because the oil is to imported. For sustainable energy growth of country, the use of renewable energy systems like solar PV power plant, provide the stable power during day hours. If the SPV power plant is implemented through grid interactive system, the power during non solar hours is imported from grid and the excess energy during solar hours is pumped into grid. The installation of 500 kW SPV power plant at REVA University campus will generate 852.4 MWh/y with an initial investment of $0.30 million will have a payback period of 3 years and 11 months and life time gain is $2.35 million. The specific energy generation is 1.70 MWh/kW/y. This will help in reduction of carbon emission (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) by 895 tonne/year that adds up the green energy revolution.

articleTitle: CNC PCB milling and wood engraving machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: CNC PCB Milling and Wood Engraving Machine incorporates the plan and usage of a CNC (Computer Numerical Control) machine to make PCB (Printed Circuit Board) and wood etching machine in a solitary set up. Creation of PCB in the present market is intensely costly when manufacture of testing circuits is considered. Along these lines, this CNC PCB Milling machine would be an effective instrument through which circuit can be scratched and penetrated at a reasonable cost. The creation of this CNC machine is to diminish the cost and multifaceted nature of machine. This venture manages the plan of programmed scaled down CNC machine for PCB drawing and processing. The proposed venture would be profoundly practical in contrast with that of customary manufacture hardware.

articleTitle: Neural network based energy conservation for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: One of the challenge of today's Wireless Networks involves parameter optimization. However the task is hard due to vibrant and changing environmental conditions. There is widespread leaning in the recent networks that includes artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, to manage design and complexity. Neural networks (NN) are one of the AI techniques well known for their outstanding simplification and flexibility. NNs are applied even in wireless networks. NNs are particularly popular classification, learning and optimization. Routing protocols based on clustering are recognized methods to extend lifetime of Wireless Sensor Networks(WSN). This work presents an algorithm designed as energy oriented clustering protocol that works on concept of self organizing map. In this algorithm factors like energy level and coordinate of sensor node are considered and based on these parameters every node is clustered. The proposed algorithm creates energy reasonable clusters and constantly distribute Energy Consumption. Simulation outcomes are compared with earlier protocol Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) prove that proposed algorithm is capable to increase lifespan of network.

articleTitle: Spamming the mainstream: A survey on trending Twitter spam detection techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In recent years, social networking sites are being referred frequently by the people, due to this the social networking sites are growing very fast. Twitter is one such micro-blogging site where the users are able to connect with new people and know what is happening in the world through the topics discussed on twitter. For this reason, twitter is targeted by malicious users who post harmful links, unwanted messages which are not of users interest which is called, spam. In this paper, a comprehensive survey on existing methods on twitter spam detection is presented. From this survey, it is clear that detecting URL content in the tweet is very important to know whether the tweet is spam or non-spam. The advantages and faws are discussed. The comparative analysis of the existing detection methods are also presented by reviewing research papers published from 2010-2017. There is a lot of scope for the researchers to carry out their research in fnding out an eff cient Twitter Spam Detection method.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis of Indian currency demonetization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Data has been playing a very important role in our day-to-day life, from every passing event, whether it is a small event or a huge event, data is always generated. Recently Demonetization took place in our country, and there had been creation of huge amounts of data. This huge amount data could be seen on social media sites like twitter, Facebook etc. This data is valuable in many senses and can be analyzed to get some deep insights about how people felt about this change in our country. This data is not only valuable for making analysis but is also valuable for predicting people's support towards present government. Furthermore, main objective will be to present different trends which are positively or negatively linked to demonetization which occurred on 8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> November 2016 and whether the people of our country are taking demonetization as a positive step or not.

articleTitle: Enhanced PSO for network reconfiguration under different fault locations in smart grids
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: According to the environments of the distribution system, avoiding the faults sometimes is not possible. Reconfiguration in power grid is a vital tool for the operation under abnormal conditions. In this paper, an enhanced particle swarm optimization is proposed for optimal network reconfiguration in smart grid based on various branch faults. The essential objective of the proposed method is to supply restoration for a maximum number of customers with minimum power loss while satisfying operational constraints. All possible fault locations in branches were pre-identified, and the faulty branches were isolated by opening the switches pair until the network is reconfigured. To ensure effectiveness of the proposed enhancement, a computer simulation has been applied to IEEE 33-bus network which is often used as a test network. The new networks are tested to realize the effect of the fault on network behavior in terms of grid security and reliability. The performances of various configurations are also compared and investigated under different fault locations. The proposed method discusses all possible faults that can occur in the grid, and provides more flexibility for the electric utilities regarding network operation and planning. The availability of optimal solution for each probable fault in the smart grid control center is the main advantage of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of PV system for a constant voltage operation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Renewable energy source based distributed power generation systems are gaining popularity because of fast depletion of conventional sources of energy and also the environmental threats they are causing. Interfacing of renewable energy sources with the utility grid is achieved using power electronic converters. Among all the Renewable sources, solar power is the most effective because of the advances in the Photovoltaic industry. Since the solar power is mainly depending on environmental conditions, the large-scale integration of solar PV has a large impact on the system stability issues. In this paper scheme for stabilising the voltage at a constant level in PV connected system. Photovoltaic system to the gird for constant voltage operation is explained. The solar PV system consists of two-stages of conversion. The two stages are, boost converter and inverter. In first stage, controller is built across the boost converter which ensures a constant voltage to the DC-link capacitor. The algorithm is implemented using PIC16F877A microcontroller. Controller reads both input and DC-link voltages to minimise the error so as to maintain a constant output voltage. The second stage involves an inverter which is capable of providing a constant voltage across the load due to the constant DC-link voltage. An IRAM 136-1061a inverter is used and the gating pulses for the inverter is generated using PWM switching operation. The full system including the boost converter, the controller and inverter is tested various irradiances conditions and it has been observed that the system is able to provide constant voltage across the inverter output terminals for all these conditions. In this paper, a system to the integration of the Photovoltaic system to the grid is designed and implemented for a constant voltage operation.

articleTitle: A generic request/reply based algorithm for detection of blackhole attack in MANET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) technology provides intercommunication between different nodes where no infrastructure is available for communication. MANET is attracting many researcher attentions as it is cost effective and easy for implementation. Main challenging aspect in MANET is its vulnerability. In MANET nodes are very much vulnerable to attacks along with its data as well as data flowing through these nodes. One of the main reasons of these vulnerabilities is its communication policy which makes nodes interdependent for interaction and data flow. This mutual trust between nodes is exploited by attackers through injecting malicious node or replicating any legitimate node in MANET. One of these attacks is blackhole attack. In this study, the behavior of blackhole attack is discussed and have proposed a lightweight solution for blackhole attack which uses inbuilt functions.

articleTitle: A method for predicting essential proteins using gene expression data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Essential proteins are important for cell development and survival for an organism. Proteins are nothing but chain of amino acids. Amino acids are of three types-essential, non-essential and conditional. Essential proteins are nothing but a chain of essential amino acids which are to be predicted. Traditionally, many methods have been used to identify essential proteins, which are time consuming, need effortful experiment approach and noxious to the organisms targeted. In this work, two approaches - Mean Weighted Average (MWA) and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) is used, this approach will not ignore any values though the duplications. Accuracy using Recursive Feature Elimination must be more than Mean Weighted Average.

articleTitle: The model of spectrum sharing between a primary and two secondary operators
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In order to lower the capital and operational costs, mobile network operators have started to consider the spectrum resource sharing on the basis of wireless network virtualization. This paper aims to develop the model of spectrum sharing between a primary operator and two other secondary operators; in which they are working together on the basis of distributed dynamic spectrum sharing in a cognitive radio network. The model is then simulated providing the interaction between user's throughput (C), packet arrival rate (λ) and the probability of spectrum occupancy (Π) In general, the greater arrival rate is proportional with an increased throughput of both primary and secondary users. However, there are certain critical arrival rate which acts as turning point of another users' throughput. That phenomenon occurs due to the influence of probability of spectrum occupancy. Therefore, it is very important for any mobile operators to maintain network performance, especially the technical parameters related to packet arrival rate and probability of spectrum occupancy.

articleTitle: BDI agent based dynamic routing scheme for vehicle-to-vehicle communication in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Design of routing protocols to send message for safety applications in VANET is an essential and required issue to support smart and intelligent transportation system. This paper aims to design and develop a dynamic routing scheme for Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication in VANET under the constraints such as dynamic topology, unpredictable vehicle density, link failure etc., using Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) model of cognitive agent. The proposed dynamic routing scheme works as follows: (1) collecting the information such as end-to-end delay and available bandwidth; (2) generation of beliefs based on the collected information; (3) develop the desire based on the belief; (4) select the route if desire is achieved and intention is executed; and (5) reselect the route if intention is not executed. Proposed routing scheme is analyzed in-terms of network life time and packet delivery ratio.

articleTitle: A classification based Parkinson detection system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Parkinson disease is a nervous disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Most of the cases go undetected due to lack of standard detection methods. The aim of this research is to propose a system that can detect this disease using data mining and machine learning. This system provides a simple yet efficient interface to upload Parkinson data, create models based on it and generate reports based on the corresponding models. Finally, the system can be used to make predictions that a person is suffering from Parkinson or not.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ZigBee based smart grid system for power management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: To minimize the problem associated existing non — renewable energy source, now a days Smart Grid is preferred because it uses both renewable energy and non-renewable energy sources to meet the total demand, digitally send meter to suppliers for more accurate energy usage, control of energy and operate power plant. Loop network technique helps to maintain reliable and secured transmission data when ZigBee network is used in Smart Grid. This paper presents the ZigBee module. The non-conventional system like solar energy system, wind energy and energy source from urban waste is also connected to Smart Grid to meet the total demand. Minimum number of wireless junctions is used to cover all consumers with continuous and renewable data supply to control house.

articleTitle: Stock market: Statistical analysis of its indexes and its constituents
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The ever-changing realm of the stock market is constantly thriving under the process of modifications and alterations. Thus, making a profit from it is hard and requires intensive planning. It is in the context of this fact that makes Stock Market analysis the first and foremost priority for any financial investment. Considering the behavioural aspects of stock prices which have a tendency to rise and fall unexpectedly, leads to a volatile scenario. However, to acquire some insight, intellectual wit and smartness to extract the best, a thorough and consistent analysis is most popular and tested way. This paper aims to determine top high performing stocks having good returns under given index that would be most safe and beneficial for investment. Using historical data we were able to obtain top stocks that are advisable for investment. We also verified our results by analyzing contemporary data similarly and found out that the performance and returns of these stocks were still high irrespective of volatility.

articleTitle: Comparison between local binary pattern histograms and principal component analysis algorithm in face recognition system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In recent years, biometric recognition has become one of the aspects for security purposes throughout IT industries. For these systems, the developer has to implement one algorithm which is going to perform recognition part successfully. This paper shows the comparison between two main algorithms which are implemented on the systems for the best performance named “Principal Component Analysis” and “Local Binary Pattern Histogram”. The comparison is based on different situations and environment around like the amount of light (artificial and natural), recognition at night time and direct sunlight.

articleTitle: An improved technique for image contrast enhancement using wavelet transforms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Image contrast is an integral part of an image. A good contrast can significantly enhance features of a picture which may earlier be hard to recognize. Underwater and medical images need to have image contrast enhancement most of the times. We have proposed here some new methods which include combination of Wavelet Transforms (both Discrete and Stationary) and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). The low frequency as well as the high frequency components from both Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) are combined and then CLAHE is applied on the low frequency part only. Then the image is reconstructed using Inverse Wavelet Transforms. Extensive experiments on a number of images, calculation of parameters like Local Entropy Increment (LEI), Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), etc. from these experiments show that this method is better than existing methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of effect of vibrations on solar panel conversion efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The proposed paper highlights the performance analysis of the effect of vibrations on the flexible solar panel. The vibrations have been produced by vibration generator embedded on the rear side of the flexible solar panel for testing purpose. The performance of the proposed system has been analyzed in terms of voltage (V), current (mA) and power (mW) obtained from the solar panel. The proposed vibration generator comprises of Lead Zirconate Titanate (PZT) material transducers having the internal capacitance of 25 nF and astable multivibrator has been used for controlling the frequency range of the vibrations for the piezoelectric transducer. The piezoelectric transducers have been connected in parallel in order to maintain a constant voltage across the system. The proposed setup analyzes the change in voltage (V), current (mA) and power (mW) when vibration of different frequencies is fed to the panel. The power variation of 1.898 mW has been observed for the frequency variation of 640 Hz. The results have been analyzed for the frequency range of 40 to 680 Hz. The maximum and minimum power output of 15.818 mW and 13.92 mW has been obtained at 360 Hz and 120 Hz, respectively. The maximum voltage and current output levels have been attained at 360 Hz and 560 Hz, respectively. The formulated results have been analyzed graphically for the voltage (V), current (mA), and power (mW) with respect to frequency (Hz).

articleTitle: Internet of Things: Review on security of novel technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The IOT colours a prescience of a world where all devices are inter-connected and incessantly continue to share our most practical information with each other. This information, in turn enables these products to deliver improved functionality and efficiency to its users, by specially customising the devices based on their requirements. However, there are grave risks involved in this kind of a world where the devices perpetually share users data among each other. With this exponential rise in the production and usage of IoT devices, one of the biggest concern that this tech obsessed society faces is security. With more and more of our household appliances and items being connected to the internet, these facilities makes these devices vulnerable to attacks. Everyday products capable of connecting to the internet are coming into the market and with them, they bring even higher security concerns. Internet of Things which is gaining more traction every day will soon be synonymous with human existence, however its boundaries are not yet well established and neither is it secure[13]. There prevail abundance of security challenges with the present architectures and the technologies which make the cornerstone of the Internet of Things. Security breaches will not only affect businesses but consumers as well and therefore the challenges are immense. The paper focuses on conducting a systematic literature review to find out security challenges faced in IoT and to provide a prospective security framework to mitigate the potentially dangerous association with IoT.

articleTitle: Automatic cradle system with measurement of baby's vital biological parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: There is a need to develop a new low cost indigenous electronic cradle because the existing cradles are imported and costly. This paper presents the design and implementation of a new indigenous low cost E-Baby Cradle that swings automatically when baby cries, for this it has a cry analysing system which detects the baby cry voice and accordingly the cradle swings till the baby stops crying. The speed of the cradle can be controlled as per the user need. The system has inbuilt alarm that indicates the condition - when baby does not stop crying with in a stipulated time, which intimated that baby needs attention. This system helps parents and nurses to take care of babies without physical attention by already recorded voice input to FN-M16P model and at this same time Cradle also moves according to the user need.

articleTitle: Realization and performance analysis of FPGA based offset quadrature phase shift keying (OQPSK) modem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Phase Shift Keying is a modulation technique employed in transmitting digital baseband data (message) from one point to other over a channel such that there is no corruption in information. This technique involves alteration of phase of the carrier signal according to base band data. Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) is a phase shift keying technique which is most recurrently employed scheme in modern satellite communication systems. Offset Quadrature phase shift keying (OQPSK) is a variant of Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) which has an advantage over conventional QPSK data transmission scheme in terms of mitigating spectral regrowth when data transmission takes place in nonlinear channels. This modulation scheme is commonly used in various communication and remote sensing satellites for payload data transmissions, telemetry and tele command systems. This paper describes design and hardware implementation of OQPSK modulator and demodulator. The proposed design is designed and implemented using Xilinx ISE software and Xilinx System Generator for MATLAB. The proposed design is implemented on Virtex 5 XUPV5110T FPGA. Bandwidth analysis, transmission characteristics, Bit Error Rate (BER), Power Analysis of proposed OQPSK modem is also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Route optimization for an electric vehicle with priority destinations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Routing of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) differs from that of the classical problem of vehicle routing in many aspects. In this paper, we address the problem of finding a route of an electric vehicle which is cost-optimized as well as considers priority destinations. Here, a PEV needs to visit all the customer locations of which some of them, defined as priority, have to be visited within a specified time duration of the day. During the trip, each location has the facility to recharge the battery and can be utilized by the PEV, if necessary. Thus, the objective of this problem is to minimize the total cost incurred due to recharging of battery. In this paper, we propose a heuristic search algorithm based on breadth first search to solve the above mentioned problem and demonstrate its performance on various testcases.

articleTitle: Modeling and performance study of DFIG for wind application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The Doubly Fed Induction Generator is the dominant wind turbine used under variable wind speed classification for wind power generation. The proper modeling of DFIG should be ensured for stability analysis. This paper deals with modeling of induction generator used for controlling the active and reactive power in the network. The design and simulation of double fed induction generator is carried out in matlab simulink. A 2MW DFIG is considered for the case study.

articleTitle: Establishing trust between vehicles in vehicular clouds: An agent based approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Trust establishment among vehicles in Vehicular Clouds (VC) is a major issue. It depends largely on sensing of reputation, and self assessment by providers of vehicular cloud services. Trust is a key parameter used to establish a secured environment to enhance the applications of vehicular cloud networks. Existing trust establishment techniques for vehicles in VC are based on the history of VC service providers and reputation. These techniques fail to perform effectively for time critical applications in dense vehicular networks. In this position paper, we propose an agent based intelligent architecture that aims to establish trust among vehicles in VC. Proposed trust establishment approach has ability to evaluate the trust based on observed data in vehicular networks to improve the accuracy of trustworthiness.

articleTitle: Structural similarity based link prediction in social networks using firefly algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Link prediction problem in social networks has received significant interest in the recent past from the researchers in diverse fields. Understanding and analyzing the present links in the social network or any complex networks either to understand their evolution or to predict the future possible links from the existing network (or links) forms the interesting link prediction problem. Link prediction based on Firefly optimization algorithm is proposed in this paper for social networks. The proposed algorithm is executed on a logical graph similar to social network and tested over real networks taking the benchmark data sets. Experimental values are compared with the other methods existing in the literature. From the comparison we can see that the proposed method performs better in terms of precision over the other methods.

articleTitle: Assessment on various node voltage stability indices — A review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the surge in demand for electrical energy and the consequent need to operate the power system close to its limits, the need to compute the voltage stability limit and the system's proximity to this limit has become mandatory. Among the methods to compute these parameters, the Voltage Stability Indices stand out owing to their attributes of simplicity and minimal computational effort and have also served varied applications. This paper presents a review on Node Voltage Stability Indices with respect to approach, values at critical point, deviation from critical point value, accuracy and response at different power factors via graphical means. The results and conclusions presented in this paper have been arrived at by performing the computations on IEEE 30 Bus system on MATLAB 8.0R 2012b environment.

articleTitle: Secured room access module
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Security is a prime concern in our day-to-day life and access control systems forms a vital link in a security chain. The New generation security system uses microcontrollers and microprocessors, which provide 100% immunity to theft and burglary. The microcontroller based secure digital lock presented here is an access control system that allows only authorized people to access a restricted area. This system comprises of a numeric keypad which is fixed outside the entry door to control the lock. When an authorized person wants to enter that area, he can release the lock by entering the right password through the keypad. If the entered password matches with the predefined password which is stored in the memory, then the door opens. Cryptography, authentication and access control mechanisms play a vital role, thereby preventing unauthorized hackers meddling with security system. The door control is carried through a relay switch which activates each time a correct password is entered, thus opening the door lock to allow access. The relay/door automatically closes after a desired time interval. An LCD interface is used to make the module more user friendly and efficient.

articleTitle: Digital MCB
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The usual problem that arises when there is an electrical fault is complete cut off of power supply to the mains. For any user, it would be quite a hassle to undergo such a problem since the user may need continuous power supply for certain real-time appliances. The faults that occur range from short circuit to an over-current situation. To address all these issues an automated system can be implemented which automatically detects the location of the fault and also rejoins the power supply. By implementing such a system, the MCB becomes completely autonomous and have a quicker response too.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of heart beat monitoring using PIC microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Heart rate is a very vital health parameter that is directly related to the human cardiovascular system. It is a physiological parameter that is measure of heart rate of an individual, indicating state of mind and physical condition. This will save time and money at a great extent and is very useful in emergency. The heart rate of a healthy adult at rest is around 72 beats per minute (bpm). We develop a project which will be an indication of how healthy our body is, by measuring and monitoring the heartbeat. The project presented here uses an infrared sensor and photodiode detector that monitors the heartbeat and LM358 is used for processing signal. The processed signal is input to microcontroller which counts pulses and sends results to LCD connected to the microcontroller. In addition to that the result will be sent to the PC via Serial cable to display the result on interface developed using C#.

articleTitle: VHDL implementation of pattern based template matching in satellite images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Image Template Matching is one of the basic problems in image processing and has applications in the field of pattern recognition and computer vision. It is a useful operation for filtering, edge detection, target detection and image registration. Template Matching is the process of determining the presence and the location of a template or pattern of an object inside the source image by using any similarity measure techniques. Conventional correlation based methods are computation expensive but have simple equation that helps in easier hardware implementation for real-time application. In this paper, a more accurate Template Matching algorithm for larger images based on correlation coefficient (normalized form of correlation) is presented with implementation in MatLab tool. Taken the advantage of template size wise processing and making use of output of generalized target detection as a mask, this algorithm can achieve high computation efficiency and good matching results even if, multiple templates may be or may not be present in the source image are involved in matching process. A VHDL implementation of this algorithm is also performed in Altera Quartus II tool.

articleTitle: A new hybrid symmetric-key technique to enhance data security of textual information using random number generator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Now a days transferring of texts, documents over the internet are the tasks in common. The transferred text must be cryptographically protected so that cannot be accessed by the invaders. In the communication medium, protected data uses cryptographic techniques and random bit generators. Once the key is generated by the random generators, how well we can secure and transmit fast in the network plays a vital role by applying appropriate algorithm. As a solution, a system is developed by symmetric algorithmic approach, uses AES and Fiestel content and also implements three different ways of random generators such as pseudorandom number generator (PRNG), linear multiples of prime sequence based method and nonlinear prime methods. Multilevel encryption and decryption techniques are adopted in the solution to transfer the information over the network securely with reduced delay. This method provides very strong technique against different kinds of attacks.

articleTitle: Segmentation of oil palm crop bunch from tree images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Segmentation is one of the challenging step in image analysis. It is very cumbersome process for the region with complex background. Segmentation techniques can be either of supervised or unsupervised in nature. In this paper, we explored both supervised and unsupervised techniques for the segmentation of oil palm crop bunch from the tree image. This work has a vital importance in Harvesting which is one of the important stages in crop management. Right time and proper crop harvesting will enhance the quality. Here we explored Hill climbing, Growcut, Random Walker and MSRM algorithm as a part of supervised techniques and K-Means, Fuzzy-C-Means as un-supervised techniques. The performance of these algorithms are demonstrated by conducting experiment with dataset of 100 images.

articleTitle: Prediction of end of discharge of lead-acid energy storage systems based on voltage gradient
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper discuss the problem of using under voltage cut-off point for preventing over discharge of lead-acid battery banks which are used as energy storage component for small-scale photo-voltaic(PV) systems. It proposes use of calculated terminal voltage gradient of individual batteries to decide the end of discharge point to prevent over stressing of weaker batteries.

articleTitle: Information hiding in line spectrum pair feature of non-voice part of speech signal
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Transmission of data in Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) must be made secure and robust such that data should not be easily attacked by intruders. Main objective of the proposed system is to hide the secret information in the silence part of speech signal for secure communication. Voice Activity Detection (VAD) Algorithm of ITU-T G.729B speech coder is performed to detect silence part of speech signal which is followed by Steganography for embedding and extraction of secret information. In order to evaluate the performance parameters for data hiding capacity in speech signal and for speech quality, the parameters like Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Absolute error (ABS), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Square Error (MSE), Mean Optimum Score (MOS) are explored. Robustness for proposed hiding scheme is performed by introducing compression attack and resampling of speech signal.

articleTitle: A review on using various DM techniques for evaluation of performance and analysis of heart disease prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In the recent years, the most difficult task in medical sciences is to foresee a heart disease. This gives birth to the necessity for the decision support system developed to predict the heart disease of a patient. In case of disease prevention and disease treatment the decision-making marks a remarking step. The increasing demand of efficient healthcare organizations are encroached with the challenges to provide cost-efficient and superior quality patient care. To cope up with the huge databases of health care information systems to discover the relevant knowledge of decision making, Knowledge Data Discovery, is carried out through data mining. The procedure involved in the efficient use of the healthcare data through extraction and pattern discovery is referred to as data mining. It also acts as a study tool to learn the veiled relationships in heart disease healthcare data. These methods reveal various consistent primary recognition systems from clinical and diagnosed data. These methods require less time and produce more accurate results. This paper contains comparisons and results of different evaluation methods. Focusing greatly on developing a prototype that reveals the veiled knowledge of heart disease from past records with the help of a hybrid genetic algorithm. Thus, helping the medical practitioners to take up the right decision on right time providing appropriate treatments.

articleTitle: Estimation of battery management system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Advancement of electronics and especially the mobility of the electronic devices is mainly due to the advancement in the battery technology. The research and development in the field of energy storage also paved way for the enormous development of the battery technology. Encouragement for the renewable energy resource also helped a lot in the advancement of battery technology. The advancement also makes the need of battery management system (BMS) an integral part of any battery driven system or device. This paper highlights on the various block of BMS and also briefs on commercially available BMS ICs which are to be used depending on the need of application.

articleTitle: A slotted multiband antenna with wide-bandwidth operation at lower band for WLAN/WiMAX applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A compact planar slotted multiband antenna for WLAN and WiMAX applications is presented in this research. The antenna consists of a trapezoidal shaped slot as the radiating patch, and rectangular and U-shaped slots as the ground plane. These slots changes the surface current distributions of the antenna, resulting in the increase in current path length, thereby making the antenna operate at multiband. The antenna has an electrical dimension of 0.21 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> × 0.23 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>×0.01λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> at a lower frequency of 2.4 GHz, and is analyzed on FR4 substrate using HFSS v.13.0 simulator. The antenna has a wide-bandwidth operation at the lower resonance with S11<;-10 dB bandwidth of about 50% (2.1-3.5 GHz). At higher resonance, antenna has narrow-bandwidth operation with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub><;-10 dB bandwidth of about 3.3% (5.8-6 GHz). Good impedance matching and stable radiation characteristics are observed across the operational bandwidth of the proposed antenna configuration.

articleTitle: Increasing accuracy of range estimation in electric vehicles using machine learning and statistical analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The paper tries to establish different ways of using statistical analysis and machine learning to effectively improve the accuracy of the mileage prediction in electric vehicles. The aim to collect sufficient amount of data from the driver while the vehicle is in use and then use the above methods to make the system is customized to the driver and the conditions that the vehicle is driven such as outside temperature, driving habits, use of temperature controls.

articleTitle: Simulink implementation of sensitivity analysis of radial distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper deals with the sensitivity analysis of Radial Distribution Network using Matlab-Simulink. Sensitivity is obtained using Adjoint Network Method. Sensitivity is calculated for load changes at more than one branch without actually changing loads in the original network. A 11KV, 12 bus Radial Distribution Network is simulated and sensitivity at desired bus is calculated using actual and adjoint network. The result is compared with load changes in actual network using Simulink.

articleTitle: A location aware telemedicine routing protocol (LATR) for healthcare in villages
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Telemedicine technologies offer an efficient form of healthcare delivery system for patients and supplements the other health care systems that already existing in the real world. This paper introduces a new and effective routing protocol that is, the LATR (Location Aware Telemedicine Routing) protocol which can be used in VANETs (Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network) to control and transfer the patient's information through highly mobile nodes. LATR is different from the other existing routing protocols as it uses the MOPR (Movement Prediction Routing) algorithm and the priority-based data transfer at free cost. The ambulance is considered to be a node which is capable of sending a patient's data to a hospital and a data response can also be sent through the intermediate nodes. The mobility of the nodes are considered to be high and the data transfer is based on the direction of the vehicles. That is, the MOPR algorithm will check the movement or direction of next node prior to data transfer.

articleTitle: HoneynetTrap: Analysis of insider threat detection using agent oriented PN2 simulator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Insider threat is one of the major concerns for an organization that breaches the confidentiality and integrity of enterprise data. Different approaches have been proposed to mitigate this problem but most of them are time consuming and ineffective. In this paper, we have proposed the use of honeytokens to curb this problem. Honeytokens are the fake data items that are created manually or generated in the real database that value lays in using those tokens by an attacker. A honeypot is used at the filtering bridge that comprises of two modules mainly, Honeytoken generation module and insider threat detection module. Malicious outbound requests are transferred to EDoS server and legitimate one is forwarded to the outside destination. We have used Petri-net based agent oriented simulator PN2Sim to simulate the proposed framework. The proposed approach has been verified with reachability property using SPIN tool.

articleTitle: Design and development of smart branched switch for home automation systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Our upcoming world needs a smarter way to control all the electrical and electronic appliances in one's home. The proposed concept in the paper will be very useful in achieving this. The control of the home appliances is achieved by the use of a single microcontroller, it has a branched structure with the microcontroller as the root memory and many RF transmitters as branches which will control many home appliance. The user interface is via an android application that runs on a smartphone that connects to microcontroller using WI-Fi where rooms can be added through application, as well as switches can be included to each room in the form of widgets thus displaying a live simulation of the network of switches in the home and shows whether they are active or inactive. The application ensures that the power is managed efficiently by indicating to the user, the connections that are turned on unnecessarily. This helps out in reducing the cost of and also saves energy.

articleTitle: Entropy based performance comparison of cryptographic algorithms on emoticons
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Securing password files has become a major issue these days. The password files are being hacked and the intruders are impersonating and tampering with the data. Therefore there is a need to supplement the passwords with strong authentication methods. A new approach of using emoticons as passwords and creating set of honeywords for the user's real password is putforth in this article. Emoticons give several permutations and combinations when compared to alpha-numeric, and special character combination and also produce higher bits of entropy in comparison with common password combinations. Honeywords (set of decoy passwords) will confuse and attract the intruder with decoy data. The probability of an intruder picking up a honeywords for accessing the resource is 95%. Whenever an intruder uses honeywords for accessing the data, an alarm will be triggered and the admin will be notified about the same. At the worst case even if the intruder has a successful login, he will be able to fetch only the decoy files but not the original data.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of clustering algorithms for dynamic VM allocation in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Cloud computing is a distributed commodity system. Authorized users can get access to the virtualized resources on demand over the internet. It refers to the utility computing model. Cloud computing virtualizes system by pooling resources from commodity hardware and supports multi tenancy. It is a highly scalable and flexible virtualized technology is flexible and scalable virtualized technology. Cloud computing provides services on demand over the internet. Users can acquire the required services in a very short time from the cloud. Services provided by the cloud are categorized based on purpose. The cloud provides services like Software as a service (SAAS), Platform as a service (PAAS), and Infrastructure as a service (IAAS). Virtual machines are employed as computing resources for high-performance computing in IAAS. Scheduling of virtual resources and virtual machines (VMs) is the key issue to be handled. Efficient virtual machine allocation is essential for effective utilization of cloud computing infrastructure and increasing resource utilization and efficient deployment of applications in the virtual machine. In this paper performance evaluation of various clustering algorithms for dynamic VM allocation is discussed. The results are verified by simulating the model in workflowsim.

articleTitle: Paradigm and performance anatomization of automatic indoor solar energy harvesting system exerting sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: “Energy conserved is life preserved”. The impetus of conservation is the greatest good to the greatest number of people for the longest time. This paper postulates the paradigm and performance dissection of automatic indoor solar energy harvesting system employing LDR sensors which results in the automatic rotation of the light weight mechanical dynamic system which extirpates the need of any additional circuitry thereby ushering to very low power consumption. In the proposed system, the energy harvesting system is self governed by the LDR sensor which exhibits maximum intensity of light thereby driving the motor driven flexible solar panel by harnessing a portion of harvested solar energy which is stored in rechargeable lead acid battery. The system steers perpetually in two mannerisms: during day time and night time. The proffered system is proficient enough to rotate according to the intensity of light sensed by the sensors. The proposed system is capable of generating average output voltage of 9.034 volts and 170.50 mA current during daytime and average output voltage of 0.702 volts and 31.4 μA current during night time.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of large wind farm based on DFIG using classical PI and fuzzy logic controller (FLC)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Due to many merits such as controllability, high energy efficiency and improved power quality, Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) can be utilized to significantly increase the energy capture. The power converter in such wind turbine only deals with power and the converter rating can be kept fairly low, approximately 30% of the total machine power. Smart grid functions more intelligently to facilitate autonomous control actions to improve reliability by designing smart controllers, integration of renewable resources, and integration of all types of energy storage to counter the variability of renewable resources, reductions voltage sags as well as other disturbances. In this paper, modeling of a wind power generation unit connected with grid using a DFIG driven by the rotor has been employed. A twelve bus multi machine system is taken as the test system integrated with the 400 MW wind farm is used. Controllers for reactive and active power between the stator and grid using vector control technique with classical PI controller and fuzzy controllers are designed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of solar based smart street lightning system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The huge amount of electrical power is consumed in lighting the streets. However, vehicles pass with very low rate in specific periods of time and parts of the streets are not occupied by vehicles over time. In this paper, we propose a system that detects the vehicle from certain radius and automatically switches on the light till the vehicle crosses a particular radius. Logically, this system may save a large amount of the electrical power and increases the lifetime of lamps. Also as the energy used for lightning is taken from solar energy at day time. Thus energy used is renewable. A GSM based system is also integrated in the design which is used to send a message to substation if any fault in street lights is detected. The major operation of this system is to save the excess use of electrical energy by using solar panels and motion sensors along with less manpower requirement since the GSM modem can detect the error and location and inform it to the station. This system automatically controls and monitors the light of the streets. It can light only the parts that have vehicles and help on the maintenance of the lighting equipments.

articleTitle: Software defined network paradigm coupled with a visualization of network functions and services in developing new network and service infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The Software Defined Network paradigm, coupled with a visualization of network functions and services, will create the opportunity of developing new network and service infrastructures. In this respect one may imagine a sort of universal node, integrating processing, storage and networking capabilities, which is able to both process and route traffic. The work provide a didactical simple model of such type of nodes by using the fluid model. The results shows the possible dynamics of the traffic in a buffer of a router integrating also processing capabilities (internal or external blades): depending on the traffic profile, and the processing requests, the evolution of the amount of data in the buffer might have a great variance.

articleTitle: Effect of micro particle contamination on breakdown voltage characteristics of CO2 in coaxial duct
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The particle contamination inside a vertical coaxial duct used in a Gas Insulated System (GIS), plays a major role in the occurrence of Partial Discharges(PD), which cause the breakdown of the insulation in GIS. This paper shows the experimental and theoretical study of breakdown voltage initiated by copper and aluminum metallic particle inside a gap insulated duct with compressed carbon-di-oxide(CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)gas, the study of effect of particle contamination on electric field distribution in the gap and the study of effect of gas pressure, gap spacing, particle shape and particle size on the breakdown voltage initiated by the metallic particle. The breakdown voltage initiated by the particle contamination is calculated by the streamer formation criterion. The experimental study carried out in the laboratory with using the pressure vessel and a high voltage AC source.

articleTitle: Eight phase MIBC for high step down ratio with closed loop control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents the design and analysis of eight phase modified Interleaved Buck converter (MIBC) with high step down conversion ratio and low voltage stresses. The proposed converter is applicable for high current applications. The switches are connected in series in the proposed eight phase MIBC along with the coupling capacitors in the power path. The ripple current of each inductor are very low compared to the conventional IBC. The modes of operation, design and analysis of eight phase MIBC is incorporated with the closed loop PI control technique. The performance analysis is compared for the eight phase MIBC with and without closed loop PI control technique. The performance analysis is carried out using MATLAB simulink software.

Author Keywords: Eight phase Modified Interleaved Buck Converter (MIBC)

articleTitle: Emotion sensing using facial recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This project aims to detect facial features from a captured image. Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) is used as the primary algorithm. After detection of the face, the next step is to extract the facial landmarks/features. Facial landmarks are used to limit and extract the salient features of the face such as eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, and jawline. In the proposed method, after feature extraction, they are compared with the features of an available data set of images, each indicating a different emotion. Once the comparison is done, the correspondence between the input image features and the features of each emotion in the data base is calculated, and the highest correspondence is declared as the emotion of the input image.

articleTitle: Design of auto wakeup alarming system for commuters in railway sleeper coaches
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Commuters need not worry any more about the arrival of their destination while they are sleeping. Train passengers will be able to wake up at the right time during the journey using the proposed device by setting their desired destination. Due to the magnification in internet's growth in the last two decades, people's expectation of getting connected to the internet independent of location is much higher. Connectivity is the vital requirement of the IoT. In the particular case of trains, providing internet access to passengers on board trains makes good business sense. Communications in IoT are envisaged through protocols such as Message Queue Telemetry Transport (MQTT). With the internet connectivity on the trains, the proposed device can access the location of the train from the NTES server and inform the commuter about the arrival of his desired destination. In some situations when the internet connectivity is missing the device uses GPS based module to get track of the location of the train. With the availability of internet connectivity inside rail coaches and even when there is no internet, we are proposing the design of an embedded device by using the GPS module in which the passenger has to just set his destination station and need not worry about missing the destination station even if in deep sleep. This Device keeps track the next station, if the next station is same as what the user has set in this proposed device, then it starts alarming to inform passengers as next station is destined for the passenger.

articleTitle: A mechanism for localization and environment supervision using wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Sensors collects data from the Physical environment and actors, they manipulate the information. Placing the sensor nodes wide access for observing the environment by the mobile sensor nodes are spread out in the river. The sensors are cognizant only about the distances from the actors and other sensors. Sensor nodes spread out in the river has its own challenges, they should be robust and posses high mobility. Localization algorithm is used to minimize this threat by aggregate data from the migrating sensor nodes then passing the input to nearby actor nodes where the sensors gather this information. The certainty of the localization algorithm can be improved with Received Signal strength and other measurement techniques.

articleTitle: Design of fractional Hilbert transformer using fractional differencing and different windows
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this paper, first the fractional Hilbert transformer and window functions are defined along with their properties and then the existing design based on fractional differencing filter is improved by using different window functions. Then the comparison of the phase responses are shown between the existing design and the proposed design using different windows. Finally, all the proposed designs are compared to identify the most suitable window for the designing of fractional Hilbert transformer.

articleTitle: NotifySec (A secured notification infrastructure)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A novel idea of this paper is to provide a proof of concept for secured notification infrastructure for an effective communication in an organization. Currently, for notification, legacy notice boards, paper and manpower are being significantly used. Recently, some organizations have started to use third party social mobile applications for the notification purpose, putting the organization's private information into the risk of improper utilization. In this work, using our proposed “NotifySec-HTTPS-webpage”, an admin can frame a message which is sent to the organization server for authentication. Further, the users of the organization can pull the notification from the server using “NotifySec” mobile application. In our methodology, we use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) protocol for communication between the server and the “NotifySec” using “OpenSSL” open-source software. Our proposed “NotifySec” works in “pull-model” at user end, for secured downloading of the notification. Hence, our proposed infrastructure is the first of its kind for secured communication within an organization.

articleTitle: Time shared buck and boost converter based H-bridge inverter for grid tied and standalone applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The decentralized energy generation is a concept that is gaining wide acceptance due to its many advantages and is predicted to play an important role in the near future. It could be an answer to find a reliable and clean way to explore the locally available renewable energy sources. For the use of renewable energy sources to surpass the conventional energy sources, it has to overcome many limitations. Compared to the conventional energy sources, renewable energy sources are less controllable, provide varying power and voltage due to many factors. But the future looks bright for renewable energy source, like the development of Maximum power point trackers(MPPT) in Solar Photovoltaic system to maximize the power generated. To handle the problems due to variable power and voltage from renewable sources, using a compatible inverter in between source and supply is a viable solution. The intention of this paper is to present a time shared buck and boost converter based H-bridge inverter for Grid tied and Standalone applications, which is well suited for renewable energy systems. The proposed Inverter can work in a wide range of input DC voltages. It can be implemented as standalone as well as grid connected with simple control techniques. The simulation results have shown that the inverter has good control performance with high quality of power output.

articleTitle: Countermeasures to security threats/attacks on different protocol layers in cognitive radio networks: An overview
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Cognitive Radio (CR) is a revolutionary technology which allows the unlicensed user to co-exist along with licensed user. It complements the wireless device by helping in improving its efficiency, reliability, and speed. New security threats have being lifted along with the understanding of cognitive radio, which thereby degrades the performance of cognitive radio. There has been a remarkable growth in security threats prevailing in CR Network (CRN) and also there countermeasure in the past decade. The main objective of this work is to protect CRN from both malicious user and licensed user. Specifically, we present various countermeasures against all possible attacks and threats in different protocol layers in CRN. The various security approaches on different protocol layers can be summarized as using error correcting codes, spread spectrum techniques, cryptographic algorithms and MAC layer admission control mechanism. With this paper, reader can have a clear idea about various countermeasures against attacks on different protocol layer and also about the research trends in this area.

articleTitle: Honey bee optimization based resource discovery scheme for vehicular cloud networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Vehicular Cloud Network (VCN) is an up coming technology for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) used for traffic management such as, storage, computing Internet, etc. in vehicles and road side infrastructures. Internet of Things (IoTs) and VCN are the key networking profound technologies of the up coming future wireless communication. Vehicular cloud networking is a complex system with a large number of shared resources. Vehicular cloud computing resource management requires intelligent algorithms for resource discovery, resource allocation and resource sharing. Resource discovery in vehicular cloud networking is a challenging issue because of the attaining accuracy in resource information when the vehicles are on fly and changes are frequent and unpredictable. We have proposed multi agent based honey bee optimization for efficient discovery of resource in vehicular cloud networks in this position paper. In honey bee optimization technique, we have used multiple mating behavior based approach to solve cloud selection problem in vehicular cloud networks. Identification of the appropriate cloud resource in minimum delay is the main contribution of the proposed research work.

articleTitle: Effective technique using nano material for controlling automobile emissions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Conversion of Hydrocarbon (HC), Carbon Monoxide (CO) and Nitrous Oxides (NOx) from vehicle emits are of high concern so as to control pollution. Catalytic converters controls the emission of harmful CO, HC and NOx by oxidizing and reducing the exhaust into CO2, H2O, and N2. Generally catalytic converter uses transition metals like Platinum (Pt), Palladium (Pd) and Rhodium (Rh). But usage of these noble metals reduce their application in automobile due to carbon deposition, catalyst fracture and high cost. The present work is aimed at using non-noble metal (Nickel) as catalyst which will has properties similar to platinum and reduced cost. It also has good durability and poison resistant nature. Al2O3 is used as wash coat material for better stability of Nickel and to prevent poisoning. In this work, we prepared various compositions of NiO/Al2O3 Nano coatings using Electro Deposition technique. These NiO/Al2O3 were coated on stainless steel mesh and characterized by various techniques like X-Ray Diffraction (XRD), Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS), and Fourier Transformer Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Atomic Force Microscope (AFM). Finally it was tested in Internal Combustion engine exhaust using Automated Emission Exhaust Gas Analyser.

articleTitle: Product recommendation for the day using fuzzy c-means and association rule generator in KNIME
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Online retail stores will need to explore various marketing strategy to attract customers. Each customer would buy a varying number of products, from the categories available. They also check for offers and recommendations before placing the orders. The design proposed is suitable for small to medium retailers. In this paper, a recommendation system is developed using KNIME tool by employing the data mining techniques like preprocessing, clustering, frequent item set detection and then use the classification oriented cluster analysis measures: the Precision, Recall, F-measure and Accuracy for verifying the results of recommendations.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of photo-detection circuit for wavelength modulation spectroscopy (WMS) based oxygen sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wavelength modulation spectroscopy is a versatile technique for wide range of applications such as determination of gas/chemical concentration, temperature and velocity/flux of gaseous molecules in industrial, biomedical and aerospace industry. A WMS based system/ sensor consists of various sub-systems. One important subsystem is the photo-detection circuit which is used to detect the laser light and condition it in accordance with the signal processing block. This paper presents the design and simulation results of photo-detection circuit using OrCAD Pspice. This design is implementedand tested for the detection of optical signal and is compared with the already established bench model setup of Tunable Diode Laser Absorption Spectroscopy (TDLAS) based oxygen sensor. The simulation results show that the designed circuit is capable of detecting optical signal in 50uV range.

articleTitle: ASIC implementation of high speed DDRSDRAM controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The double data rate synchronous dynamic random access memory (DDR SDRAM) has turned out be a key device for the designs due to its speed and pipeline features and hence it is used in computers. This research is to develop a DDR SDRAM controller which is capable of generating the signals for memory refresh, write and read functions and also initialization of the DDR SDRAM to transfer the data using the designed controller. The ASIC implementation can be done using cadence 45nm CMOS technology. Further optimization can be done using other physical design optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Processing and mechanical characterization of Al2014-B4C aerospace composite
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The experimental work was aimed at evaluating the effect of B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>C reinforcement on Al-2014 alloy, which effects hardness, tensile strength, and compressive strength, and wear properties this composites. These Aluminum metal matrix composites with individual and multiple reinforcement are finding increased applications in aerospace, automobile, space, underwater and transportation applications. An effort is made to study the properties of aluminum metal matrix by reinforcing Al-2014 matrix with varying proportion of Boron carbide by stir casting method. Aluminum Al-2014 alloy matrix of varying proportions of 90 micron boron carbide particulates were fabricated with the addition of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>TiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> as a wetting agent. The microstructure and strength properties of the fabricated Aluminum metal matrix were analyzed using Scanning Electron Microscope and Energy Dispersive Spectrometer. The microstructure study revealed the homogeneous dispersion of B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>C particles in the matrix. Based on the results obtained from the hardness the metal matrix composites it is observed that, the hardness is increases with increase in the amount of reinforcements. Even though in the case of tensile and compressive strength is increased with increase in B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>C reinforcement.

articleTitle: Analytical evaluation of five level inductor coupled inverter topologies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Impedance source inverter has be en proposed peculiar converter with both Voltages boost and buck capability. Now withstanding the general property, the Z-source inverters have the limitations of requirement for lower modulation index at higher voltage gain which gives high dc link voltage but results high voltage stress in semiconductor switch, high starting inrush currents due to resonance at starting. To diminish these impacts, magnetic couple inductors are analyzed to boosted gain, modulation ratio concurrently, while diminishing the number of semiconductor switches required. This ρ aper presents performance analysis of different five level magnetic coupled impedance source inverter topologies using simple boost pwm technique using Matlab / Simulink.

articleTitle: Implementing interchange of legal data under information system using a subset by deriving on the form of akoma ntosa in context of right to information by encoding application and appeal
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Our law enforcing system called as Indian Legal System is lacking in terms of computerisation intelligent enough to enable law open for everybody. We are moving towards Digital India in all spheres of activity. In our country majority of people are not aware of the law of the land. AKOMA-NTOSO is an international technical standard for representing judiciary documents in addition to executive & legislative in a structured manner.
