We can call it XML vocabulary on law and it suggests also a convention of giving name for providing unique identifier to legal sources based on FRBR mode. There is no effort has been made to create standard representation of law in India. The subject matter of the paper goes into detail of creation of standard representation of parts of RTI Act 2005 for its implementation under a given circumstances. The process model of second appeal was undertaken. It was found that majority of RTI appeals at CIC are returned only for the reason that rule 8 and 9 of the RTI Act has not been fulfilled. The study captured the process of filing second appeal and created a schema of representation of various components and system prototype to check the compliance before accepting second appeal. The schema was created using subset of AKOMA-NTOSO schema, XML & HTML standard. The result shows that quality of services are improved by eighty percent(80%) and it has the potential to augment the way to create schema for entire RTI ACT. There are challenges associated with complexities in judicial system and quality of encoding of law on the basis of schema created and development of system to act accordingly. The study provided evidence that data on law can be interchanged among various system with semantic and technical interpretability.

articleTitle: Modeling of single arm poly silicon actuator gripper with constant heat flux boundary conditions and stress analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents modeling, simulation and stress analysis on micro-gripper with constant heat flux applied. The device is symmetric in geometry, so one side of the device is designed. When electric potential is applied, temperature increases in poly silicon resulting in displacement of the material. The displacement of micro-gripper arm is used for manipulating micro particles. The displacement involves coupled physics i.e. electric current conduction, heat conduction with heat generation and change in structure due to stress and strain. FEA simulation is carried out to verify the design and stress analysis is done.

articleTitle: Disruptive technology for auto insurance entrepreneurs: New paradigm using telematics and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Currently, Motor insurers are playing a passive role in terms of identification of risk incidents for the policy holders. Traditional insurance does not differentiate safe drivers and unsafe drivers. Since they do not have the vehicle telematics data of the policy holders. Many insurance corporations are planning to utilize telematics data to build a model of predictive risk for policy holder and claim possibility. They can reward safe drivers by low premiums and/or no-claim bonus. Likewise, unsafe drivers need to pay extra risk premium. This means drivers have a stronger incentive to adopt safer practices. This paper describe black-box auto insurance predictive model utilizing basic telemetry like GPS sensor data for usage based insurance. Predictive model is developed using binary logistic regression machine learning technique. It is an informative paper for entrepreneurs since it highlights the business proposition from an insurer perspective to gain competitiveness in highly commoditized insurance market.

articleTitle: On road card using IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Rising traffic congestion is an unavoidable condition in growing metropolitan areas across the world. Since, the majority of people use personal vehicle to commute, finding a parking space is a tedious task. Currently, the parking and toll system is semi-automated everywhere. This paper introduces a solution to cope with the mobility problem by using “Smart cards” incorporated with IoT to completely eliminate human intervention and alleviate traffic congestion. To facilitate this, a user-friendly website is proposed that displays 3 webpages i.e., to book a parking slot, to cancel the booked slot, to recharge the “Smart cards” and to view the Toll transactions. The hardware portion of this prototype consists of a system with sensor networks that communicate with the website to update the database.

articleTitle: Temperature analysis for modeled saw tooth flexure micro gripper with constant heat flux boundary conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents modeling simulation and temperature analysis on micro-gripper with constant heat flux applied. Half part of the device is designed as it is symmetric in geometry. Electric potential applied, at its anchors will cause displacement of the material. The application of displacement is used in biomedical application. The displacement, Electric current conduction, caused heat generation and change in structure due to stress and strain takes place. Finite Element analysis is carried out to verify the design and temperature analysis is done.

articleTitle: An optimization of single stage power factor corrected AC-DC converter with appreciable steady-state performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The harmonic content is the major problem in supply side devices. So, in order to reduce this use of active PFC is mandatory in these converters. If the compensator placed in the feedback loop at output is narrow in its bandwidth, the dynamic response of the Power Factor Corrector (PFC) is slow. However, the input current THD, power factor and voltage ripple are appreciable. If the compensator placed in the feedback loop at output is broad in bandwidth, the response of the PFC is faster but the voltage ripple is more where as THD and power factor are significantly less in value. In this paper, proper investigation has been done to find the range of the K (factor of ripple voltage on the control signal) which decides whether the system to have fast / slow response with power factor, THD and voltage ripple is appreciable values. The major variations of K are due to the variation of time constant (RC) of the controller. The results are verified through MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Formulation of impact of voltage — Change in the radial power-flow with tap — Change transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The demand for electrical energy is ever increasing in the World. For that an AC (Alternating Current) Power Distribution is most commonly used system in operation. Approximately 20% of the total electrical energy generated is lost during transmission (4-6%) and distribution (15-18%). In this context, it is necessary to minimize the distribution losses, which intern improves the amount of power significantly. An industrial customer supposed to reduce the losses in the low tension-side under tolerable voltage limit. In case the customer is failed to maintain the system voltage well within the limit, then unnecessary penalty is charged by the power supply board. As per the demand and service, it is necessary to place tap-change transformer or regulating transformer to maintain the acceptable voltage limit. For that, first various literature reviews were collected on role of tap-changing transformer in power distribution study. Further, the paper developed formulas on the impact of tap-changing transformer in the distribution power-flow study. The updated formulas used to determine bus-power, bus-current and bus-voltage. Furthermore, the role of tap-changing towards saving of real power cost is estimated. To obtain the load flow solution, the input-data details of the network containing tap-change transformer were fed into modified power flow equations. The proposed algorithm is successfully demonstrated on an IEEE 15-bus network and voltage regulation are presented. The test results obtained are validated through MATLAB Version: 9.2.0.538062 (R2017a). The proposed method presented in the paper is found to be flexible and efficient.

articleTitle: Multifunctional HD receivers for smart homes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: High Definition receivers like Set Top Boxes (STBs) act like an important communication hub in each homes as it is very frequently used. Smart and multifunctional receivers will play a major role in making smart homes. Designing the receivers with multifunctional and user friendly features will add the values to the concepts of smart homes. Handling different types of signals, transforming one form of the signal in to another and receiving broadband through a new concept called TV white space are some of the features of new generation HD receivers. Smart receivers add value to create smart homes and smart cites.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of content based video retrieval system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The fast advancement of the video technology has lead way to design and develop algorithms in this aspect. Out of which, the most important aim will be to develop algorithms to perform video systemizing, categorizing, and retrieval. The basic step here is to input the keyword or phrase of the regarding video of interest. This will lead to browsing of data in the large database with sufficient content representation. The system is addressed here using two algorithms namely Similarity Measure and Euclidian Distance and the results are obtained and plotted for accuracy check and also time analysis check. The best one here is thus obtained.

articleTitle: Control strategy for an induction-generator in TSCAOI mode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The paper deals with a analog based voltage regulator for two series-connected and one isolated phase winding of a three phase self-excited squirrel cage induction generator, driven by a prime mover speed. Induction generator requires variable excitation source to keep output voltage constant. The variable reactive power can be supplied by the proposed controller consisting of comparators, relays and secondary tapped transformer. The generator output is dependent on the excitation source (both voltage and frequency). The output voltage varies with load or prime mover speed, rectified and compared with the desired reference. The Comparator is used to switch a relay, the contacts of which are connected to the excitation. Depending on the error voltage a variable excitation voltage is applied to the machine to restore constant output voltage using secondary tapped transformer as the excitation source. The proposed controller is modeled and simulated in MULTISIM environment.

articleTitle: Design and performance analysis of autonomous indoor solar energy harvesting system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: “The preservation of natural resources is the rudimentary muddle. Unless we decipher that muddle, it will avail us vaguely to elucidate all others”. This paper posits the design and performance anatomization of autonomous indoor solar energy harvesting system employing a light weight mechanical dynamic system which eradicates the need of any additional circuitry thereby leading to very low power consumption. In the proposed system, the energy harvesting system is self governing the motor driven flexible solar panel by harnessing a portion of harvested solar energy which is stored in rechargeable lead acid battery. The system maneuvers relentlessly in two mannerisms: during day time (6:00am-6:00pm)and night time (6:00pm-6:00am). The proffered system is proficient enough to rotate both in clockwise and counter clockwise direction. The proposed system is capable of generating average output voltage of 9.034 volts and 170.50 mA current during daytime and average output voltage of 0.702 volts and 31.4 μA current during night time.

articleTitle: An efficient approach of taking quick and simple notes in the air through smart note taker
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Today's modern living is creating a great hype in each and everyone's life. On the off chance if we take a gander at the entire picture there is race going ahead amongst individuals and everybody needs to win. To vanquish this rodent race innovation acts like a weapon. So in today's quick and mechanical life a weapon like SMART NOTE TAKER is one that fulfills the requirements of the general population. This gadget can be extremely valuable for the general population who needs to take fast notes. This innovation has one exceptional quality that it permits you to compose notes in air and after that the notes can be stored on the memory chip in the device. These composed notes are then readable in digital medium once they are completed.

articleTitle: Implementation of Doppler shift compensation algorithm for Underwater OFDM communication systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper addresses the effect of Doppler shift on an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signal, in underwater communication in the presence of attenuation and ocean noise. The Doppler shift disturbs the orthogonality of OFDM signal which results in poorer Bit error rate (BER). Thus there is a need to mitigate the Doppler shift at the receiver. In this paper, a Doppler shift compensation algorithm is devised in presence of pathloss and ocean noise for coherent applications. At the receiver, a method to estimate and compensate the Doppler shift has been carried out using two banks of parallel self-correlators. For SNR in the range of 30 to 35 dB, with initial BER 0.5 has been reduced to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> after coarse compensation and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> after fine compensation at reduced hardware complexity using the developed algorithm. The proposed algorithm is initially simulated using MATLAB and later results are verified on a Zynq board (ZC702) also. The obtained results are compared with that of single step estimation and compensation algorithm.

articleTitle: Road traffic network solution in Matlab using soft computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Congestion due to traffic is considered to be a major problem in Urban Areas. Due to Traffic there is a lot of delay in the travel time. In order to avoid this problem it is very important to select an optimized route in the traffic network where it is considered as the shortest paths under various constraints. In this paper a multiobjective genetic algorithm is proposed which is programmed in Matlab to find the best possible route in a directed graph which represents a traffic network.

articleTitle: Cloud computing usance among SMEs: Comparative analysis of China and Nigeria
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Cloud computing is an emerging technology in recent years and has been very beneficial to Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs). However, not many SMEs have adopted this technology to explore the opportunity therein. This paper discusses the potential benefits, level of adoption and usance of cloud computing among SMEs in China and Nigeria. The paper went further to identify the margin that exists between the level of adoption of the two countries and also point out some of the challenges peculiar to each country that prevent the full adoption of cloud computing among SMEs and finally make suggestions on how the Nigerian SMEs can improve their enterprise using the cloud computing. In addition, the paper provides evidence-based intervention for cloud service providers, the private sector and the government to improve the adoption of cloud computing among SMEs to ultimately drive the enterprises for the potential economic benefit.

articleTitle: On the reduction of large sparse matrices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The security of well-known cryptographic system RSA is dependent on hardness of factoring large integers. In cryptanalysis of RSA and also other symmetric encryption algorithm, one gets a sparse system of linear equations which needs to be solved for a few solution vectors. The linear system (or matrix) coming from RSA is special. It is very large and extremely sparse, means each equation involves very few variables. The well-known Gaussian elimination technique is not suitable for handling such a large matrix. The matrix should be reduced first to a smaller one one but still sparse, in order to avoid problems such as memory crash. Thus, a small improvement in the methods for reducing the matrix will have a significant impact on the total running time for factoring integers. This paper addresses the problem of reducing a given sparse matrix and possible solutions for an efficient implementation.

articleTitle: Information harvesting @Intelligent systems using cloudlet and IOT in cloud systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the advent of IOT (Internet of Things), according to Cisco in 2025, around 5 billion network devices will be connected to each other and then, it will be very difficult to handle such huge amount of data produced. The solution will be Intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Infinite level inverter based DSTATCOM for power quality enhancement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Ideally, the goal of power industry is to supply a purely sinusoidal voltage at fixed amplitude and frequency. This paper presents a three phase Infinite Level Inverter(ILI) based DSTATCOM for harmonics and reactive power compensation. Its high DC link utilization reduces overall voltage stress across the device and hence improved power quality. It uses well established synchronous reference frame (SRF) strategy to generate current references. Mathematical and simulation modeling is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink environment using Simpower systems library. Hardware realization of a three phase infinite level inverter and single phase infinite level inverter based DSTATCOM is done using simulink real time windows environment.

articleTitle: Cluster analysis of a decade of Indian space activities based on an ontological framework
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this paper, cluster analysis of Indian space activities is presented. A recent decade of space activities from 2007 till 2016 is analyzed to understand the priority of Indian space programme. A total of 486 press statements from authentic sources namely Press Information Bureau, Department of Space, Government of India and Indian Space Research Organization are used for the analysis. The clustering results in priority distribution of Indian space programme. These observations from the analysis can be utilized along with similar indices, to maneuver the space policies to maximize benefits to citizen and hence to humanity.

articleTitle: Peer-to-peer knowledge sharing platform for farmers with auto-recommendation feature
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Agriculture is one of the rapidly expanding fields. Proper arrangements of adequate information of agricultural activities that are practiced by small farmers constitute a key element to improve their livelihood by providing useful knowledge. Information Technology is closing the gap between every person in the world. Agriculture has a wide scope to progress with evolution in Information technology. Technologies and practices keep changing continuously. These rapid changes pose a question on how to spread that knowledge among the farmers and other stakeholders. The progressions in IT provide solutions on sharing knowledge among the farmers and other stakeholders. Farmers in India are not aware of advancements in effective hi-tech cultivation processes, sowing and reaping mechanisms and irrigation technologies and they do not get enough opportunities to interact with either the progressive farmers or the expertise. This is a very critical issue, which has to be handled in an innovative way. An appropriate infrastructure is to be provided for sharing information of agricultural practices and knowledge by the intelligent farmers. In this context a framework is proposed to resolve the issues of the farmers by their peers. In other words a transparent peer-to-peer knowledge sharing system, networking all the farmers and experts is to share and inherit the agricultural knowledge is presented. This system shall increase the efficiency, productivity and sustainability in agricultural produce.

articleTitle: Cascade ciphering technique for confidential, authenticated and integrity preserved transmission of images over a network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Rapid growth in the internet usage has contributed to large amount of data or images that are getting transmitted via network. With the purpose of faster delivery of data, especially images such as the one in medical, military, scientific related fields are also transmitted via network in a very large amount. In these cases, protection of confidential images becomes very crucial. The confidential images should not be easily able to be seen by the third party other than the one whom the images are intended to be sent. It becomes very important to encrypt these confidential images before transmission over the network, to prevent unauthorized access. So, a new cascaded encryption system is proposed in this paper for secure image transmission. The proposed cascaded encryption system is based on A5/1 and Pell's algorithms. Here, A5/1 is used for data confidentiality, the Pell's algorithm is used for authentication and the integrity is ensured through correlation. The proposed method shows better results in terms of standard deviation, encryption and decryption without information loss and faster encryption as well as decryption time as benchmark set against cascade encryption with RSA with AES algorithm, RSA with A5/1 algorithms.

articleTitle: Web oriented FIM for large scale dataset using hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In large scale datasets, mining frequent itemsets using existing parallel mining algorithm is to balance the load by distributing such enormous data between collections of computers. But we identify high performance issue in existing mining algorithms [1]. To handle this problem, we introduced a new approach called data partitioning using Map Reduce programming model. In our proposed system, we have introduced new technique called frequent itemset ultrametric tree rather than conservative FP-trees. An investigational outcome tells us that, eradicating redundant transaction results in improving the performance by reducing computing loads.

articleTitle: Smart vehicle communication using vector based forward routeing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this modern era, vehicle safety and traffic-free conditions are the crucial needs to provide a successful and failure free transportation systems. In Intelligent Transportation System [ITS] applications, reliability and accuracy are the major components needed to handle several applications such as safety systems, real-time traffic monitoring, tolling evaluations and so on. Different applications include Collision shirking or Moderation, path change administration or crisis braking help frameworks, depend essentially on the exact and solid information of vehicles situating inside given region. In existing methods, we achieve time delay and energy loss. So in the proposed system, we can provide reduced energy loss using vector based forwarding one hop algorithm. This framework consider each every vehicle get their own particular supportive node arrange in closest region when need to transmit any data and also refresh their position and send RREQ (Route Request) to closest wireless node and sit tight for RREP (Route Response) after selecting one hop node with high vitality and send the message one by one until the data reaches its destination node. Unlike searching for RSU as in existing methods the proposed Vector-Based Forwarding Routing [VBFR] algorithm makes use of certain specific supportive nodes for communicating information thereby minimizing the energy loss. This algorithm is implemented in NS-2.35.

articleTitle: Vehicle state estimator for urban autonomous solution POC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: An Autonomous vehicle is a driverless vehicle which is an emerging area in automotive industry across world. In an autonomous vehicle, the Advanced Driver-Assistance System (ADAS) is an indispensable component which is developed to automate, adapt and enhance vehicle systems for safety and better driving. The key factors in the ADAS are reliable vehicle's position and orientation. In the present system, Global Positioning System (GPS) receivers with a real time kinematics (RTK) are used in autonomous vehicle. But the reliability of GPS signal and orientation accuracy is not satisfactory because of its inherent limitations. In this paper work, the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) which is combination of sensors and GPS are integrated with Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) to overcome the limitations in the present system, thus a navigation algorithm is proposed for autonomous vehicles. The proposed algorithm methodology involves recording of the data from the GPS and IMU simultaneously and processing those obtained data in the EKF to reduce the accumulated errors. Then it is integrated in the iterative process of the filter, which gives the final positional data. In the driver less environment, the Dead Reckoning (DR) is a condition when there is a loss of GPS signal and the vehicle position depends on IMU data. The on-field performance trials with DR are conducted and evaluated for different real-time urban scenarios with both simulated results and pre recorded data on the demo path.

articleTitle: Green libraries by using smart technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A green Library is designed to minimize negative impact on the natural environment and maximize in door environmental quality by means of careful site selection, use of natural construction materials and biodegradable products conservation of resources (Water, energy, paper) and responsible waste proposal (recycling etc). Green Library is a part of Green building movement. There are several reasons why library would want to build green or incorporate green features into their buildings by using Smart Technology. First, the cost of constructing green buildings has become affordable. Second, most reading available energy resources to finite resources. Smart Technology means basically monitors and analysis of the hard drives which helps the workplace to save money and Energy. In this article., how by using smart Technology in Green Libraries reduce energy consumption, smart technology revolution to the development of Green Buildings by using mobile tools for accessing digital information and modernizing Library Missions.

articleTitle: Effect of physical parameters on the magnetic field of a conductor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper aims at explaining the effect of physical parameters, temperature and stress, on the magnetic field created by an individual electron, which is subjected to relative motion by an externally applied electric potential. It brings to light about the dependence of the magnetic field of the conductor on its physical parameters like length and area. The variations in temperature and stress will result in the variation of its physical parameters. It also explains how the individual magnetic fields of the electron is responsible for the skin effect in high voltage alternating current (HVAC) transmission lines.

articleTitle: Design and development of LTCC based package for 3-axis packaging of MEMS sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: There is a wide range of applications for Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) based devices which are used in automotives, aerospace, mobile communication etc. Sensor fabrication and its packaging are very closely connected for reliable functioning of the module. Packaging for MEMS based devices should necessarily provide mechanical support, environmental protection and of course the electrical interconnections to the device. Low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) technology is widely used for packaging of MEMS devices and sensors. Being machinable at green stage LTCC offers the flexibility of structuring for customized package design. This paper attempts to develop LTCC based package for 3-axis packaging of MEMS based sensors. For sensors like accelerometer where 3-axis measurement is required in many applications either the device needs to be fabricated in such a manner that it can detect acceleration in 3-axis or the single axis sensitive device may be packaged in such a way so that the packaged module may detect acceleration in 3-axis. These devices involve the movement of the proof mass, therefore special packages with a built-in cavity are also fabricated. The dedicated cavity provides required space for the movement of the proof mass without any hindrance. Thick film alumina based packages have also been developed.

articleTitle: Prediction capability of neural network models for higher heating value used for boiler efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Quantity of heat produced during the complete burning of a unit mass of coal is indicated as Higher Heating Value (HHV). Accurate measurement of HHV of coal within the specific time is an important step in mine processing and power plant operations for the optimized operation, emission control and economic operation of the coal fired power plant. HHV is computed using the coal properties which are obtained through the proximate analysis or ultimate analysis. The proximate analysis yields moisture, ash, volatile matter and fixed carbon whereas the ultimate analysis yields carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen and Sulphur as coal properties. Existing techniques of HHV determination are either linear or non-linear. As the relationship between the HHV and Coal properties are non-linear in nature, Neural Network (NN) and Wavelet model are suitable for HHV determination. Compare to NN, wavelet model estimates more accurate results but does not support real-time and recursive characteristics seen in NN. Hybrid model of wavelet and NN called as Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) has good prediction capability in non-linear environment. Hence, the prediction capability of WNN with respect to HHV estimation is analyzed in this paper by comparing the Mean Square Error of WNN and NN. The obtained result from our developed WNN and NN model for HHV estimation shows that WNN is better than NN.

articleTitle: An experimental design approach for power factor correction using PLC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Power factor correction (PFC) is a way of negotiating the annoying possessions of electric loads that craft a power factor lesser than one. Power factor correction may be applied by an electrical power transmission utility to enhance the efficiency of transmission network. Low power factor is ordinarily not an immense difficulty for housing loads, becomes a problem in industries where several motors are paralleled operated for multiple functions. Hence, in industries the correction of power factor has become awful necessity. Major task of our research work is to rectify the issue and provide a fruitful solution. Though there are various means available for correction of power factor with certain pros and cons. Generally, PFC Capacitors are employed to unravel the problems using pacific methods and in some way active techniques as well. Each method has its own drawback in terms of it employment cost and computational intricacy. In the proposed technique, the PLC for the PFC is employed.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of MEMS based acclerometer in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: MEMS Sensors are devices capable of collecting the data from the surrounding physical environment and converting it into the useful electrical signals for interpretation and analysis. With the growing complexity in MEMS devices and their need in almost all embedded systems, (e.g., Wireless devices) demands a systematic way for MEMS design, modeling and fabrication. In this paper, modeling and behavioural analysis of MEMS based accelerometer is carried out so as to get the knowledge regarding its working for various inputs. The validation of the results was done by connecting the accelerometer sensor already integrated in the mobile through the Matlab Mobile appliction available in the Google Play store. The model was capable of detecting the acceleration value of up to ±5g. MATLAB/ Simulink tool is used to model and analyse the accelerometer sensor.

articleTitle: Cloud broker and their role in a hybrid multi cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: We present a view of the emerging cloud market and the role and impact of cloud broker organizations in a Hybrid Multi Cloud Environment. As the cloud market matures, the number of clouds consumed by the Enterprises will multiply. In such a scenario, it becomes increasingly complex for an Enterprise to manage a multi cloud environment. In this paper we present how a cloud broker organization can inject itself between the cloud provider and cloud consumer organizations and provide brokerage services for cloud consumers. This paper will also briefly explain how traditional service organizations are transforming themselves into a cloud broker by investing on cloud specific IP's and management frameworks.

articleTitle: Distribution reliability indices calculation and utilize neural network model for radial system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The reliability indices that have been evaluated using classical concepts are the three primary ones of average failure rate, average outage duration and average annual unavailability time or average annual outage time. These values are not deterministic values but are the expected or average values of underlying probability distributions. Although the three primary indices are fundamentally important they do not give a complete representation of the system behaviour and response. [1, 2] Hence in order to reflect the severity or significance of reliability value it is required to evaluate these five indices. SAIFI (System Average Interruption Frequency Index), SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index), CAIDI (Customer Average Interruption Duration Index), ENSI (Energy Not Supplied Index), and AENS (Average Energy not Supplied index). And neural network back propagation algorithm is applied for reliability indices evaluated.

articleTitle: Data theft prevention using user behavior profiling and decoy documents
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: There are abundant safety concerns in cloud computing and major concern is data theft attack. The standing measures of security like encrypting-decrypting are not able to prevent insider data theft attack. This paper presents an approach of offensive decoy technology to prevent insider data theft attack. Here technology is executed by constructing a prototype based on web pattern which validates the effectiveness of decoy technology. This application doubts unauthorized access and throws challenge questions besides hurling disinformation attack using decoy data. Thus averts insider theft.

articleTitle: Data-driven motion correction for human head in computed tomography
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Human head motion while obtaining Computed Tomographic head scans results in motion artifacts that resemble long streaks in the CT images. These artifacts hide anatomies and hence can lead to misdiagnosis. An under-scan weighting function, that manipulates Sinogram data to reduce motion artifacts has been optimized and validated for clinical CT head images. It requires manual segregation of CT head images into motion and motion free subsets by visual analysis. The optimized under-scan weighting function is used to normalize the Sinogram of the CT head image that is affected by motion artifact. CT head images corrupted by motion artifact and the ones generated from Sinograms corrected for motion artifacts are visually and quantitively compared. Motion artifacts lead to increase in noise in the streaky regions. Motion correction algorithm results in noise reduction in the streaky regions. The same have been verified.

articleTitle: A survey of deployable tools and techniques for a smarter power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Smart Grid and Internet of Things (IoT) are the latest trends respectively in the domains of Power Engineering and Computer Science. The amalgamation of the two presents enormous potential to improve the efficiency, security and reliability of the power grid. In this paper, the authors review the existing solutions and propose their ideas, as an improvement over existing techniques to make the Power Grid smarter-more reliable, efficient and secure. The topic of Electricity markets and analysis of power system data to extract meaningful information that help in enhancing power system performance and control are also discussed.

articleTitle: Optimizing the cable designs for wind energy applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wind power has increased dramatically over the past recent years in worldwide. In order to promote more and more wind farm connections, researchers are directed at improving technology, lowering costs, and addressing the challenges to greater use of wind energy. Though the cost of the collector conductor network is about 5-10% of the total CAPEX of the wind farm, any reduction of cost associated with the collector network is welcomed by the wind industry. In this study the optimization of collector conductor network of wind farm applications is presented. The results shows a significant material reduction in collector conductor network, which helps in rapid future development of wind power industry.

articleTitle: A new cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter with reduced switch count
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This script recommends a new module for cascaded multi-level inverter. It utilizes reduced number of switches with higher number of output steps. Due to less switches, driver circuits, conduction losses and switching losses are minimized. By attaching several modules in series configuration we obtain desired number of output levels. The projected MLI structure includes series connected modules and one supplementary block generates only all un idirectional positive voltage. To get bidirectional voltage an H-Bridge is connected. In this script proposed MLI employs SPWM strategy. In general L level multi carrier SPWM requires (L-l) carriers. But i η proposed topography only (L+l/2) carriers are sufficient. Due to less usage of carriers controlling circuit becomes less complex, size and installation cost also reduces.

articleTitle: Users perception about Online content and information design on apparel websites
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Background : As lives become more fractured and jumbled, it is not surprising that customers attract to the unrivalled convenience of an Internet when it comes to searching and buying product. Method : A case study on an apparel website and its information content was done. A questionnaire covering aspects such as demographic variables, behavior and information content desired was collected. A statistical analysis was done to examine the influence of the apparel related information design. Results : The study examines the information content and design on online apparel retail store and users perception. People who buy apparels online preferred to have technical details about garment. graphical representation available on website, order details, size charts and access to negotiate with the vendor before buying. Conclusion : The study finds the web based information content can exhibit a role in users perception.

articleTitle: Procedural ailment detection system — A web based healthcare approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Healthcare has evolved at a rapid pace, and with its evolution has arrived the need for an Information Technology system able to serve the basic purposes while evolving with the times. Procedural Ailment Detection System is a Software as a Service (SaaS) approach to simplifying the fundamental problems associated with digitization of healthcare to the masses. It is a system implementing a variety of web services and resources to enable a technological medium which allows for end users to identify ailments, connect with hospitals, find basic medical advice and gain a medical forum. This system is better than the other services on offer because it utilizes a data mining approach with respect to the datasets it has at the beginning and gains over time, which when mapped to the interactive UI, essentially allows for a more efficient system with a far higher cognitive ability.

articleTitle: A novel DC-DC converter applied in solar energysystems for low & high voltage DC applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Presently now a-days because of the deficiency of electrical power, increasing expense of non-sustainable power source assets producing electric power from the sustainable power source assets, for example, PV modules are expanding every day. This venture presents PV based framework which comprises of front end converter and a back end converter used to bolster high voltage and low voltage loads. The front end converter is a non-separated, high stride active DC-DC converter using half and half transformer with for low voltage sustainable power source assets solicitations. The suggested converter uses half breed transformer to exchange the both inductive - capacitive vitality at the same time, accomplishing high stride up voltage with littler measured attractive segment, the kill impairment of difference is limited, growing the adequacy of the converter underneath all heap situations. By swapping the info voltage the voltage weights on the dynamic switch and diodes remained kept up at stumpy level and are free accordingly of the resounding capacitor exchanging vitality to the yield of the converter. In view of extraordinary system capability in addition furthermore capability to work by an extensive variable input voltage, the suggested DC-DC converter stands an alluring arrangement in place of substitute low DC voltage imperativeness sources, for instance, sun situated PV modules and power gadgets. Though back end converter is a solitary switch buck converter which used to venture down the vitality from that point it provided to low voltage loads upto 30V DC. A pi based criticism control framework is connected to back end converter to accomplish fancied load needs. Numerical demonstrating of PV board, the most extreme power point following is utilized create the greatest power by incorporating a gating PWM to front end converter. All framework is displayed in Matlab/Simulink and results are checked.

articleTitle: Energy harvesting system based WSN application using ARM7 controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A wireless sensor network (WSN) is used in many applications such as Inventory control, Mobile technologies and Radar system tracking. The sensors are connected in a network manner which communicates with one another. A microcontroller is an important component of a wireless sensor node, also called Mote. It has to perform the measurements using the integrated peripherals, to post process the measured data as well as to coordinate the data transport of the wireless sensor network (WSN). The lowest possible power consumption is also a key requirement. This work demonstrates the flexibility of the microcontroller that is needed to adapt a Mote to a specific application area. In this case, the application area is RIVER MONITORING. One requirement is a perpetual operation using energy harvesting. This work presents the first water level monitoring platform only using ultra-capacitors as energy storage elements to compensate the irregularity of environmental energy sources.

articleTitle: Detection and tracking of objects using thresholding technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Today, there are so many people with visual impairments. With the advancement in technology, the responsibility to invent new methods to assist the visually impaired users have been increased. In this paper, the colour of the objects and their positions are identified. The colour of the objects is found using thresholding technique. The threshold values can be varied if required. The threshold values are set separately for red, green and blue colours. If the threshold is set high, then only the objects with high colour intensity are detected and if the threshold is set low, the objects having low to middle colour intensity could also be detected. Position of the object is determined by taking the position of its centroid as reference and is displayed in terms of Cartesian coordinates i.e., X-coordinate and Y-coordinate. Also, the number of objects detected is shown on the monitor.

articleTitle: Quality of service in MANETS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: MANETS (Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks) are the collection of movable nodes which themselves are self-configured, these nodes are attached by wireless links without the need of any centralized authority. These nodes in the networks work as host and router as well. With the increase in wireless technology in our society MANETS are popular and essential today. The main objective to describe this paper is to explain the existing protocols and their performance comparison, also some modification is done and the simulation is performed to know about the throughput, packet delivery ratio, standard deviation energy, average residual energy, first dead node in different protocols are shown in the thesis. In this work we are going to explain AODV, DSR and modified DSR protocols with the performance analysis using simulation results, the modified version of DSR and its advantages are briefly explained along with the simulation result. The different algorithms are used in this work, the comparison shows which algorithm based routing protocol works effectively.

articleTitle: Design and performance analysis of high gain microstrip patch antennas employing leather substrates for earth exploration satellite applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The study of various types of microstrip patch antenna designs employing different leather substrates having different dielectric constants on the realization of microstrip antenna has been carried out in this paper. The types of leathers employed as substrate in the proffered antenna designs are the brown leather with εr=1.54, white leather having εr=1.67 and black leather with εr=1.62. The thick-ness of brown leather, black leather and white leather is 1.8 mm, 2.8 mm and 2.25 mm, respectively. The propounded antenna employing brown leather as substrate has the return loss of -54.49 dB with the corresponding resonant frequency of 8.20 GHz operating in the frequency range of 7.98 GHz-8.45 GHz. The propounded antenna using substrate as brown leather has high gain of 8.33 dB and directivity of 8.24 dBi and percentage bandwidth of 5.73 percent. The propounded antenna employing white leather as a substrate has return loss of -15.4 dB within the operating frequency range 7.59 GHz-8.00 GHz with the corresponding resonating frequency of 7.78 GHz. The gain of the propounded antenna using white leather substrate has high gain of 8.06 dB and directivity of 7.99 dBi and percentage bandwidth of 5.26 percent. The observed return loss of the propounded antenna employing black leather is -11.06 dB with operating frequency range of 7.64 GHz-7.88 GHz with 7.75 GHz as the resonating frequency. The simulated gain using black leather as a substrate is 7.90 dB and directivity of 7.85 dBi with percentage bandwidth of 3.09 percent. CST Microwave Studio 2016 has been used for the construction of propounded antenna. The fabrication and successful testing of propounded antenna has been done using anechoic chamber and E5071C network analyzer. The experimental and simulated results have been tested and it has been observed that the practical results nearly match with simulated results. The antenna realization has been analyzed using three different types of leather as substrates and it has been concluded that the antenna consisting of brown leather as substrate gives the optimum performance having minimal losses.

articleTitle: Integration of RFID and sensor in agriculture using IOT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Agriculture is the backbone of the Indian economy. As all know that demand of agricultural products are increasing day by day as the population is ever increasing, so there is a need to minimize labor, limit the use of water and increase the production of crops. So there is a need to switch from traditional agriculture to the modern agriculture. The introduction of internet of things into agriculture modernization will help solve these problems. This paper presents the IOT based agriculture production system which will monitor or analyze the crop environment like temperature humidity and moisture content in soil. This paper uses the integration of RFID technology and sensors. As both have different objective sensors are for sensing and RIFD technology is for identification This will effectively solve the problem of farmer, increase the yield and saves his time, power, money.

articleTitle: Performance dashboard: Cutting-edge business intelligence and data visualization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Executive decisions are the core components affecting the growth of the organization. While one right decision can make the business to reach the sky, one wrong decision can bring down the business. With the increasing competition of IT industries, the investments, business directives and the business data are increasing exponentially. Hence, the business owner should be extra cautious and must keep all the factors in mind while decision making. Thus, demanding a great requirement of a tool which measures and monitors the growth of the business and to evidence that the business is heading towards the profitable direction. Even though there are few existing methods to measure the growth of the company, these are limited to provide basic information or have restrictions in analyzing the behavior of the business. Therefore, fail to provide the complete assurance to business owners in decision making. This work provides an efficient Nobel solution to address these problems by focusing on developing a Performance Dashboard. The proposed technique involves an integration of business intelligence technologies, data mining and data visualization technologies creating a perfect solution to analyze the business trends, business growth, the amount of profit, employee performance, customer satisfaction, areas of improvements in business and much more. This performance dashboard showcases the information by understating the business behavior right from the organization start period. It acts as an information management tool that is used to track the metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and additional key factors applicable to the business or specific process. Using data visualization techniques, dashboard simplifies the complex data sets to deliver users with a glancing awareness of present performance and to keep track on the department's capability to accomplish service level targets.

articleTitle: A novel approach: Cloud-based real-time electronic notice board
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The role of information and communication technologies (ICT) in universities is not a new concept in the current world scenario and with Indian government schemes such as “Digital India”, it is now more approachable and executable. The old traditional bulletin notice board system provides a scope for digitization with replacement using a much faster and efficient electronic modular notice board system which is paperless and reduces physical methods of maintenance and operations. This paper proposes an electronic cloud-based architecture for an e-notice board system for Rashtrasant Tukadoji MaharajNagpur University and can act as a seed model for smart universities in India, which consists of Light Emitting Diode (LED) monitors displaying textual, image or document notices generated through this system's Android smartphone-based or Web desktop-based applications. The proposed approach uses Java and XML languages for its Android application and Angular JS for its Web-based application with back-end cloud database system as Google Firebase for real-time syncing. A small micro-computer such as a Raspberry-Pi can be used for display purpose on the monitors by projecting a web browser. The system comprises of a Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) system and an external hosted MySQL server for delivering notifications based on the notices generated through the system. The entire system is modular with scalable and secure authentication levels, offline-notice generation support, realtime syncing of notices across all connected devices (smartphones, desktops and LED monitors) and an omnipresent cloud support. The system provides individual department as well as university level notice feeds.

articleTitle: A survey on clock synchronization protocols in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Networks(WSNs) are important in the maintenance and monitoring of smart cities. The various activities in a smart city must be monitored periodically. Data aggregation, surveillance and tracking are done by the WSNs with the help of sensor nodes. The sensor nodes are the basic units of the WSNs. Each sensor node operation is timed by an inbuilt hardware clock. All the sensor node clocks must have the same notion of time for collision free transmissions. Therefore their internal clocks must be perfectly synchronized. In this paper, we present clock synchronization protocol that aim at synchronizing the clocks of sensor nodes. We have classified the protocols based on the propagation of the clock parameters and compared them on the basis of different performance parameters.

articleTitle: A survey on enhancing the interoperability aspect of IoT based systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internet of things has become the buzzword of the technology world. It has given rise to a huge number of IoT deployments consisting of millions of IoT based devices which are heterogeneous in nature. As the number of components increases there is a huge demand for robust infrastructure with very less issues in terms of connectivity, traffic of data, Security, Privacy, and Interoperability. Among all these issues this paper focuses on the impact of interoperability in IoT. This issue becomes critical in hard real time systems which require constant monitoring of data. Several methods are in use to address the interoperability issues. This paper will discuss about the challenges and issues involved with the existing methods and the future aspects to control them.

articleTitle: Every post matters: A survey on applications of sentiment analysis in social media
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Social media is often used by people to express their views about everything around them. Twitter is considered as a major microblogging site where each post by the user is publicly available. Due to the public availability, it makes Twitter the most popular social media for analysis of opinions of the masses for various purposes. These purposes range from predicting an election winner to identifying the polarity of people towards a particular brand. This paper provides an introduction to Sentiment Analysis and the importance of pre-processing of texts in social media. With a detailed description of how performance evaluation is done, it looks into research works which make use of Twitter data in order to obtain insightful details in various domains and help identify the trending research areas within Social Media Analysis.

articleTitle: Fast and secure random number generation using low-cost EEG and pseudo random number generator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Random numbers are currently being used in a wide range of applications; hence there is a need for methods to generate them in a cost effective and flexible way. Current implementations involving physical phenomenon as in true random number generators (TRNGs) and computer algorithms as in pseudo-random number generators (PRNGs), when used individually or in combination, provide random sequences but with inflexible approaches and higher cost factors. This paper aims at combining the advantages of both the random number generators (RNG) to overcome their limitations. The study proposes a method of providing random sequences with the help of neuro-signals, extracted using a low resolution, inexpensive and portable Electroencephalogram (EEG) device. The raw EEG signals do not pass the standard randomness test suites and thus cannot be used directly. Hence, this paper proposes a novel approach of transforming the raw EEG signals to random sequences, emulating a TRNG, whose output can then be used as seeds to drive a PRNG. The obtained numbers passed the standard randomness test suites.

articleTitle: A learning styles based recommender system prototype for edX courses
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Recommender Systems (RSs) are information filtering systems that gather data about users, to build useful recommendations for them. In todays age of bigdata, RSs have become important tools for finding relevant items from numerous options. RSs for web-based learning assist learners in discovering relevant learning content, according to requirements. Since learners have diverse needs and contexts, recommendations need to be highly personalized. In web-based learning, MOOCs are globally accessible online courses, designed to support learning of a large number of students of different backgrounds. For modelling users, existing MOOC RSs focus on extrinsic properties such as demographics, ratings, whereas a students learning is more dependent on intrinsic qualities like competency, learning styles. In this work, a new RS prototype has been designed, for recommending MOOCs based on requirements and learning styles. This prototype is based on an adapted version of the FSLSM LS model and works exclusively for edX MOOCs.

articleTitle: A narrative review on offshore wind power transmission using low frequency AC system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Offshore wind power generation, transmission and integration around the world are becoming higher, and it provides technical and economic challenges for future practitioners and industries to make an alternative transmission system to an existing system in reduction of cost. In most of countries, e.g. The German government planned to install 25000MW of offshore wind farms by 2030. The greater part of offshore wind farms are integrated with High Voltage AC (HVAC) transmission to the onshore grid. Offshore wind farms are integrated with High Voltage DC (HVDC) transmission for long distances (>50km) to the grid because of capacitive cable current in HVAC. The major challenge in HVDC transmission is the installation, operation and maintenance (O&M) of the Voltage Sourced Converter (VSC) HVDC substation in the offshore climate. Currently, in case offshore wind farm the research have been fastened to reduce the complexity with increasing reliability and minimizing cost. This paper gives a comprehensive review of integration of offshore wind farm via Low Frequency AC or Fractional Frequency AC (LFAC or FFAC) transmission. LFAC transmission is adopted from HVAC and it is operated at one third of nominal frequency (16.67 Hz). As compared to HVDC the main advantage of LFAC is an absence of the offshore converter station, hence system complexity and cost reduced. In design considerations, especially the offshore transformer is one of the challenges. This paper presents a comprehensive review on components and its design considerations of offshore novel LFAC transmission. The offshore wind turbine considerations, collector network and different types of onshore frequency converters explained in detail.

articleTitle: Iris recognition: A symbolic data modeling approach using Savitzky-Golay filter energy features
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for iris recognition through symbolic modeling and symbolic similarity analysis of iris features, which are transformed using Savitzky-Golay filter. The proposed approach is based on iris Savitzky-Golay filter energy features. Prior to symbolic modeling of iris feature data, Canny edge detector and Hough Transform technique is used to segment iris region from the eye image. In the normalization stage, Daugman's rubber sheet model is used to obtain a fixed size rectangular block from segmented iris region to account for imaging inconsistencies. Using Savitzky-Golay filter, iris features are obtained by computing smoothing coefficients from normalized iris region. Further, the extracted features are represented as symbolic object by employing symbolic data modeling approach. The symbolic similarity analysis technique is employed for computing similarity between probe iris image and symbolic objects. The symbolic object which represents maximum similarity is considered as a resultant object. The SGGSIE&T and CASIA-Iris 4.0 Interval databases were selected to evaluate the performance of proposed model and achieved 99.33% and 95% recognition rates respectively.

articleTitle: Multimodal affect recognition in V-A-D space using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Now-a-days one of the most challenging problem is automatic affective state recognition. To identify emotions from physiological signals a knowledgeable and advanced learning algorithm is required that can represent high level abstraction of signals. This study presents the deployment of deep learning network (DLN) to determine unspecified feature interrelationship between input data. The DLN is implemented with two semi-supervised algorithms i.e.; Stack auto-encoder (SAE) and Deep Belief Network (DBN) individually on DEAP database for emotion state classification. A Bayesian inference classification based decision fusion method is used to improve the classification and the results has been improvised by almost 3% in case of valence and arousal of DBN and almost 15% and 6% in SAE than the individual classification results of SAE and DBN, however in case of dominance the result has been improved by almost 9% than SAE.

articleTitle: IoT standardization efforts — An analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internet of Things aims to connect various things around us to the Internet with the use of smart sensors and actuators. IoT devices have limited resources in terms of power, processing capabilities, bandwidth etc. but the existing set of protocols were not designed for such constraints. Gartner Inc. forecasts that the total number of connected things will reach 20.4 billion by 2020. The specific needs of the IoT domain should be addressed considering the huge scale of implementation and its influence on public life. There is a need of a standardized layered architecture and protocol suite designed specifically to meet the need of IoT applications. Various consortia are working on developing IoT standards majorly driven by government agencies, standards bodies and industry giants. We present the various initiatives at international level and at national level, in India, towards developing IoT standards. Although the world still waits for a unified IoT standard but lately major efforts have taken place at international level, through collaboration and liaison agreements, towards the convergence of various standardization efforts. Such developments raise the hope of universal IoT standards in the near future.

articleTitle: Ranking of Internet Service Providers considering customer priorities using multiple criteria decision-making methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internet Service Providers are generally commercial, non-profit, privately owned or community-owned companies that provide various telecommunications services including data communications access and telephone connection for various users. It has become the most influential part of our life, as it offers endless connectivity between the end-users. As a result, the count of Internet Service Providers has significantly increased in current times and unfortunately customers are restricted to use the service of an unknown provider. During such circumstances, a user should be encouraged to choose the Internet Service Provider according to his own priorities. This makes it necessary for an application which acquires the priorities from the end user and provides a ranking of Internet Service Providers. In our paper, we have applied multiple criteria decision-making methods to provide ranking of internet Service Providers based on the user priorities acquired. This paper also focuses on applying the above decision-making methods to the service providers available in the Indian market.

articleTitle: Quiver — An intelligent decision support system for software architecture and design
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: These concepts of Decision making and the approach towards informed decisions have evolved into the class of systems called Decision Support Systems(DSS). The four factors involving accuracy of the model, representation format, response time and cognitive style, are critical to success of these systems. The most important characteristic for quality of the system is the accuracy of the model. Successful DSS make judgements that model the best human technicians. Over the years the focus on learning from domain experts and prediction or inference has increased manyfold. So is the technological advancement in these areas. Software Engineering has evolved over many years but stays significantly human centric as it relies significantly on the technical decisions made by humans. Modeling the problem statement and arriving at architecture and design fuses in the minds of software architects and designers and considered highly human centric. It is identified that improved architectural decision making involving reference architectures with context, solution and rationale well explained using decision trees could benefit decision making. Considering the insights gained from previous work and the generic nature of existing frameworks and architectures, the authors propose an Intelligent Decision-making Support System in the area of Software Architecture and Design.

articleTitle: A comprehensive citizen engagement framework for effective resolution of public complaints in cities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Across the world, many nations have successfully implemented complaint management solutions for diverse complaint types, so as to promote open government initiatives and other policies. The issues reported include potholes, broken sidewalks, flooding, garbage, etc. In Sri Lanka, there are many issues with the current public complaint management process which have led to citizens being dissatisfied. Based on this background, the project aims to analyse why citizens in key cities in Sri Lanka are dissatisfied with the process; and design, develop and evaluate an IT solution to reduce this dissatisfaction, while creating a conceptual framework for effectively incorporating the solution into the complaint management process. In creating an effective conceptual framework and IT solution for complaint management, attitudinal factors, social factors, technological factors and knowledge and communication factors affecting citizen participation in complaint management initiatives were analysed based on existing literature. These factors were validated via interviews with government officials and questionnaire distribution amongst citizens. Building on this, the conceptual framework was formulated, incorporating a complaint management IT solution for citizens.

articleTitle: A survey on technique for prediction of disease in medical data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In today's era data mining plays important role for prediction of diseases in medical field. With the growing research on disease predicting system, it has become important to discover hidden patterns and relationships from medical databases. In classical clinical diagnosis, it requires lots of tests which could complicate the disease prediction. Hence the data mining techniques can help medical expertise to take the decision about the disease using computer aided decision support system. In this paper comprehensive survey on various data mining techniques used for disease prediction is presented.

articleTitle: A predictive methodology for non-critical load scheduling in autonomous micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The power balance achievement in the autonomous micro-grid is a mandatory case which is always required reliable solutions. As the power disparity in the micro-grid is related to both generation and demand sides, the centralized control methodology is the proper way to achieve the power balance with respect to both sides. In this paper, a centralized based predictive methodology for non-critical load scheduling has been proposed. The proposed method has utilized to achieve the power balance and avoid the occurrence of peak demand during the diminution of renewable energy production. Furthermore, the method attends to obtain the maximum exploitation of the energy stored in the battery by the aid of generation prediction and load forecasting. Therefore, the need of running the conventional generator has been mitigated. The related results have clarified the validity of the proposed scheduling method to reduce the operation time for the diesel generator to the least possible time.

articleTitle: Predictive analytics for safer smart cities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The threat of incendiary and often, catstrophical terrorist attacks is a major challenge for the urban administrators. The urban landscape is changing at a fast pace with the emphasis moving toward “smart cities”. Terrorists, for obvious reasons, prefer attacking cities compared to rural areas. Smart cities are expected to absorb larger populations of inhabitants in smaller area implying the damage inflicted by these attacks would be maximum unless some preventive mechanisms exist in the smart city ecosystem. There exist very few methodologies for attack forecasting due to lack of real-time data (confidentiality and reluctance of law enforement in sharing data). In this paper, we propose a way to predict future attacks, weapons used and likely targets using a class of powerful machine learning algorithms known as ensemble learning. The features used to train the model are location, attack type, weapon type and target type.

articleTitle: Gujarati handwritten character recognition using grey level co-occurrence matrix and dynamic time warping technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Gujarati language belongs to the Devanagari family; consists of characters and digits with typically sharp curves and few of them have similar shapes. Misrecognition of Gujarati Handwritten characters are mainly due to the existing similarities in their shape. To enhance reading capabilities of handwritten Gujarati characters and reducing optimal training time, automatic character recognition is the process in which the computers detect and identify the scanned/ captured characters. Major application area of Gujarati handwritten character recognition (HCR), includes post offices, schools, colleges, etc., in Gujarat. In this work a dataset has been prepared which consist of 170 Gujarati handwritten character (5 samples each of 34 Gujarati consonants), acquired with high resolution smartphone camera (13 MP 1/3.06 inch sensor). Further, an investigation on effectiveness of combination of grey level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) and dynamic time warping (DTW) method for Gujarati HCR has been performed. The reason that GLCM features are used because it improves the recognition accuracy by reducing computation time and misrecognition of characters with similar shapes. Out of the three experiments performed, it has been observed that experiment 3 yields better recognition accuracy of 99.4% for the dataset under consideration.

articleTitle: A comprehensive investigation on machine learning techniques for diagnosis of down syndrome
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Down Syndrome is a chromosomal disease which causes many physical and cognitive disabilities. Down Syndrome patients are more vulnerable than any other patient. Medical experts started knowing it now with keen awareness. In recent years it has become a field of interest for many researchers, medical experts and social organisation. For the researchers it is an area of interest where very little work is done and a lot to be explored. Machine Learning consists of different processing levels like pre-processing, segmentation, feature selection and classification. Each level contains a vast set of techniques like filters, segmentation algorithms and classifiers. Machine Learning is one of the most popular algorithm, which is used to automate the decision making process with higher rate of accuracy in less time with least error rate. Machine Learning proved its significance with highest rate of accuracy in decision making and problem solving in almost all the fields but automated decision making in medical science is still a challenge. This paper reviews the different works done in the field of Down Syndrome using Machine Learning applied on different medical images, and the techniques like pre-processing, segmentation, feature selection and classification. The aim of this research work is to analyse and identify the Machine Learning methodologies that works efficiently to detect Down Sundrome.

articleTitle: Breast cancer awareness through smart mobile healthcare applications from Indian doctors' perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Breast cancer is the most common cancer in women worldwide, with nearly 14.1 million cases diagnosed globally in 2012. In the same year, there were 8.2 million deaths from cancer in the world making breast cancer the second most common cancer overall. Also, India has one of the highest cases of breast cancer. According to WHO, for the year 2012, an estimated 144,937 women in India were newly detected with breast cancer and 70,218 women died of breast cancer in the same year, more than any other country in the world. This indicates a beginning of an epidemic which requires effective intervention to reduce the incidence of breast cancer, thereby reducing mortality.
