In the last few years, a lot of global initiatives on breast cancer have been taken by the World Health Organization (WHO), the International Breast Cancer Research Foundation (IBCRF) and Pink Ribbon International (PBI). These international bodies are addressing and creating awareness on breast cancer. One such initiative is the mobile applications that can can provide people with breast cancer, survivors, and caregivers convenient resources and tools to guide them through their treatment and keep their life more organized. Many researchers and scientists have come up with mobile health (m-health) apps to prevent and promote breast cancer awareness to the public. Though there are many mobile apps available on itunes and google play, people are not aware of the apps' purpose or it is not promoted well. The main purpose of this article is to analyse how breast cancer health apps (such as iBreastCheck) can help in primary prevention, early diagnosis and palliative care of breast cancer in India from doctors' perspective. Focus group and questionnaire survey was carried out to understand the adoption and acceptance of mobile health apps for breast cancer awareness by doctors for the Indian public. The focus group and the online survey statistical results demonstrates the need and importance of using mobile health apps to prevent, detect and treat breast cancer, which means Indian doctors have a positive approach towards recommending breast cancer mobile health apps to women.

articleTitle: Predictive analysis techniques for road accident injuries: A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The term accident is precisely described as an occurrence of such events which are generally results in coincidental injury, loss of life or property damage. Therefore in order to reduce the severity of these injuries, the motor vehicle crashes has become a problem for the highway agencies and vehicle manufacturing companies since ages. With introduction of every new motor vehicle the risk is getting higher. The improvement is in turn determined by the decrease in crash severity over the time span, deep understanding into the success of crash reduction methods, rules and regulations needs a more accurate empirical judgement, factors depending on roadway and human resulting injury severities. Over all these previous years, different studies has been evaluated the effect of such variables of crash severity data by using wide range of methodological tools and present methodological approaches made it possible to develop the sophisticated models that has the ability to estimate the influence of all these significant factors accurately across the world. Motor vehicle injuries and it's severity level are the major problem, this arises the need to tackle these issues with immediate prominent actions, with best possible methodological techniques as of now. This study aims to mainly focus on the evaluation of the past studies over the period of time and current situation to summarize the analytical study of vehicle crash severities and presents some methodological direction for future which will help to investigate the causes of collision.

articleTitle: Mobile governance — A complement for successful eGovernance (Study on Challenges in mobile governance)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Digital Governance is transforming the world in the new era of digitalization. The world is shifting the focus from eGovernance to Digital governance. Government of India is initiating many services to reach the citizens in electronic form. But, there are many challenges to be addressed to navigate these services to reach the grass root level. Providing Infrastructure to various parts of the country is one of the major Challenges. The other objective of providing the services to the citizen anytime, anywhere, any type of device is a further challenge. An excellent solution to achieve this objective is mGovernance. mGovernance is mobile governance using mobile devices, PDAs, handsets and with wireless infrastructure. Mobile governance is compliment to Digital governance. Mobile Technologies provide new opportunities as well as key solutions to face challenges. But providing too many mobile solutions is not the solution for citizen adoption and reaching the services to grass root levels. And it may lead to more confusion to a common citizen. This paper would attempt to address key determinants to improve eGovernance by studying implementation of various mobile governance initiatives at national and international scenarios.

articleTitle: A review on detection of prostate cancer techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Deciding on the most instructive cancer-related genes from outsized gene expression database is a significant and compelling bioinformatics research topic. Prostate Cancer (PC) is globally prevalent type of cancer among men. Bio-markers approach as obligatory tools for therapeutic and evaluation since the impulsiveness of disease performance, the cost constraint, symptomatic of cure, associated miserable life style, which is required for efficient early detection technique. Fast-throughput equipment platforms in proteomics and genomics, increased the growth of bio-markers. In addition, latest developments on some agents in PC, as well as immune-therapy inspired to seek for predictors of reply and resistance and they have enhanced the thoughtfulness about the biological activities. There are many unanswered questions surrounding Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) testing. The test is not accurate enough to either completely rule out or confirm the presence of cancer. In this paper, we review various techniques used for the detection of prostate cancer. We discuss how bioinformatics can be used to enhance the evaluation methodology.

articleTitle: Smart grids: A perspective on the integration and encapsulation of power energy systems with ICT systems — New research directions and challenges
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The idea of Smart Grid was floated and proposed as a potential solution to address the current challenges faced by electric utility companies: surging power demand, overburdened grid capacity and aging infrastructure. These challenges make the grid vulnerable to frequent overloads and outages. Electric Utility Sector was also blamed for polluting the environment with usage of fossil fuels [1] by releasing CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and there by damaging the nature (2). This paper presents different perspective for the integration and encapsulation of power energy systems with information and communication technology system which lays strong foundation and new research directions for the smart grid researchers.

articleTitle: A hybrid method for activity monitoring using principal component analysis and back-propagation neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Human activity recognition is a useful topic of research as it recognizes various human activity ultimately helps in monitoring of patients in hospitals, elderly people at home etc. In this work a hybrid method using PCA and ANN is proposed for activity classification. Principal component analysis is used to find the important features from a number of features. In this work 381 features are selected from 561 features. Selected features are used as input to the ANN based classifier to recognize different human activity. The accuracy of the proposed activity classification method is 96.8%. Hence the proposed PCA and ANN based hybrid method can be used effectively for human activity recognition.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection systems in MANETs using hybrid techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The use of self organized wireless technologies called as Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) has increased and these wireless devices can be deployed anywhere without any infrastructural support or without any base station, hence securing these networks and preventing from Intrusions is necessary. This paper describes a method for securing the MANETs using Hybrid cryptographic technique which uses RSA and AES algorithm along with SHA 256 Hashing technique. This hybrid cryptographic technique provides authentication to the data. To check whether there is any malicious node present, an Intrusion Detection system (IDS) technique called Enhanced Adaptive Acknowledgement (EAACK) is used, which checks for the acknowledgement packets to detect any malicious node present in the system. The routing of packets is done through two protocols AODV and ZRP and both the results are compared. The ZRP protocol when used for routing provides better performance as compared to AODV.

articleTitle: Harmonie mitigation in multi feeders by using MC-UPQC system with the predictive ANN & SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper aims to develop a Multi-Converter Unified Power Quality Controller (MC-UPQC) and analyses the performance with PI controller, artificial neural network (ANN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). MC-UPQC system is able to compensate voltage and current distortions simultaneously in multi feeder systems. Shunt compensator is used to regulate the current disturbances and series compensator is used to mitigate voltage disturbances. The shunt compensation is carried out in the main feeder and the series compensation is carried out in all the feeders connected in multi feeder system. In this project, power quality can be improved in multi feeders connected to two different power substations by using MC-UPQC and observe the difference between ANN and SVM controller. In this arrangement both the Shunt-VSC (Sh-VSC) and Series VSC (Se-VSC) are connected to common DC-link capacitor. Implementation is done by using MATLAB and the obtained results are compared. The performance analysis is done by using different controllers.

articleTitle: Extract reordering rules of sentence structure using neuro-fuzzy machine learning system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Recent development and enhancement in the field of soft computing which is the cutting edge of Neural network and fuzzy logic. Here by we are proposing a solution using Deep Neural Network (DNN) and Fuzzy logics for Natural Language Processing (NLP) with is the sub part of Artificial Intelligence (AI). If we look India we have 22 constitutional human languages and in the world around 6909 living human languages. Building cross Machine Translation (MT) system using these all language which currently not possible because of lack of resources, knowledge and etc. If we have huge corpus of source and target language this propose system will automatically find out the grammatical structure of source sentence matching with the target language using Neural network and fuzzy logic and it is flexible machine learning technique it deals with uncertainly or vagueness existing in a system and formulating fuzzy rules to find grammar structure to a given new sentences.

articleTitle: Pharma data analytics: An emerging trend
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Clinical data analytics or pharma data analytics is the recent research trend having an impact on big data, pharmaceutical industry and genome analysis. It's a very prominent thrust area, as it collides with genome and clinical data all the time. The size of the data collection is very huge with the advancement in the technology. Pharma industry is also growing day by day contributing for the growth of business intelligence. The pharma data is found to be unstructured and needs a different approach to handle. The present work gives an insight of big data approach to clinical data, details of different machine learning tools to handle, how the role of genome analysis is involved in the study and lastly a business perspective of pharmaceutical industry. The study also reveals that mimic is one of the important data source for this analysis and exploring mimic is also part of the work. Major contribution towards this work is identification of the data processing tools mimic-II and stata and it is found that of the available machine learning techniques support vector machine is found to be more suitable.

articleTitle: A poly_hop message routing approach through node and data classification for optimizing energy consumption and enhanced reliability in WBAN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wireless body area network (WBAN) is emerging as one of the most advanced remote health monitoring networks. It consists of different wearable or implanted personal computing devices with variety of resources for providing multiple functionalities. Routing plays a key role in WBAN to gather the sensor data and route through intermediate nodes to reach the destination with minimum amount of energy. As WBAN consists of miniature sensor devices with less amount of energy, we should never burden the sensors with more computations which may result in drastical drainage of battery. In this paper, we have proposed an efficient message routing approach through multiple hops and node classification, so that energy consumed by individual sensors can be less. As WBAN deals with medical sensitive records, data needs to be transmitted securely. So, we have also addressed another downside of using WBAN, i.e., reliability. To enhance communication reliability in WBAN, we have proposed classification of transmitted data so that more security can be provided to the crucial messages compared to regular messages. The novelty of this approach is that data prioritization is done dynamically at the tier-2 of WBAN. The proposed approach is validated by comparing the result with that of a conventional approach.

articleTitle: Unit vectors of SRF control algorithm based DVR for power quality improvement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Today India trends towards the Research Development as the Research leads to make the country developed. In all the several Disciplines in Research Power System shows the great embark in development. DVR is used for compensation of Voltage sensible problems like swell sag etc. The Unit Vectors of SRF control algorithm used for the compensator plays a major role in power quality improvement. Unit Vectors of SRF Synchronous Reference Theory is considered as control algorithm for the compensator. Generally, control algorithm generates the reference signal. In the conventional SRF control algorithm the reference is generated with the help of Phased Locked Loops but it consumes more time. Hence this paper proposed the unit vectors for the generation of references for the load voltage. Hence the generated reference signal is compared with load voltages. Thus, obtained error is converted into the pulses with the help of a PWM converter and is given to DVR. Form the pulses DVR inject this error into the system and compensate the power quality problems. The projected DVR is simulated in Matlab 2012a and the results are validated by simulation results.

Index Terms: Controller In The Synchronous Reference Frame
Author Keywords: Unit Vectors of SRF Control Algorithm

articleTitle: Remote control of an electronic device using EOG
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Over 1 billion of the world population have some form of disability which corresponds to 15% of the world population. And this disability suppresses their ability to communicate with the physical world. The proposed prototype provides an opportunity for such people to be self-reliable and enhances the ability of the disabled people to operate the electrical and electronic devices remotely, without the assistance of fellow beings. This prototype aims at providing an eminent platform for disabled people to communicate with the physical world at an equitable price. Human eye is capable of producing a corneo-retinal potential whose magnitude varies from 0.4–1mV with a frequency ranging from 0–35 Hz. This is attributed to the high metabolic rate of retina. The proposed model exploits this appealing property of human eye. It encompasses the ECG electrodes to trap this potential and is fed as an input to the amplifier circuit. Further, the amplified signal is conditioned using a signal conditioning circuit to remove the noise creeping into the signal. This is wirelessly transmitted using an RF module to the receiver circuit and from there it is used to trigger the required circuit. A LED is triggered to ensure the functionality of the framework.

articleTitle: Intelligent motion control of bots using hill hold assistance mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The power consumption and torque constraints in the motors of vehicles pose a restriction to their ability to traverse steep slopes and hills that have steep curvature. When the vehicle is stopped and then started on a hill or slope, there is a tendency to roll-back before moving forward. These roll-backs pose a threat when the preceding vehicle is close by and can lead to accidents. Hence solutions have emerged to avoid slipping of vehicles on steep sections of hills. The objective of this work is to present a stand-alone hill hold assist function to prevent the robotic vehicles from roll-backs while climbing a steep hill. The adaptive motion planning of the bots is illustrated using the scenario where the vehicle is standstill at the base of a hill. The bot should first alter its direction so that it gathers sufficient momentum before traversing the hill. The vehicle equipped with the stand alone Hill hold functionality can ascend smoothly on a slope, without skidding.

articleTitle: Continuous tracking of maximum power point of PV array with controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The work focuses on continuous tracking of maximum power point (MPP) with a controller which proposes a hybrid MPPT algorithm which consists of fractional open circuit voltage, fractional short circuit current and perturb and observe method of MPPT algorithms. This includes choosing the battery unit whose terminal voltage depends on the current-voltage characteristics of PV panel and the maximum voltage of the load to be connected. The battery capacity is sized such that, when load is in need of supply, battery will provide power and when there is not enough charge in battery, it will be charged by PV array when there is solar irradiation, thus enabling the natural protection of battery from being overcharged or undercharged. In addition to this, the work focuses on continuous tracking of MPP of PV array with a controller throughout the work duration and creating a database of the same.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of solar photovoltaic cell models
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents the performance analysis of various solar photovoltaic (SPV) cell models by comparing the voltage, current and power output under normal and partially shaded conditions. The SPV panel consists of solar cells arranged in series-parallel to get the required output. The SPV panel output will be voltage, current and power. This output is completely depends on the solar irradiation and temperature. This paper compares the output of Ideal and general models of the PV cell under normal and partially shaded conditions. The simulation is carried out with the help of the Matlab/Simulink software and the performance of the various models of the PV cell is compared against the output voltage, current and power in terms of P-V and I-V curves under normal and partial shaded conditions.

articleTitle: A geometric approach for recognizing emotions from 3D images with pose variations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Emotions are an incredibly important aspect of human life. Research on emotion recognition for the past few decades have resulted in development of several fields. In the current scenario, it is necessary that machines/robots need to identify human emotions and respond accordingly. Applications in this field can be seen in security, entertainment and Human Machine Interface/Human Robot Interface. Recent works on 3D images have gained importance due to its accuracy in real life applications as emotions can be recognised at different head poses. The intention of this work has been to develop an algorithm for recognition of emotion from facial expressions, which recognizes 6 basic emotions, which are anger, fear, happy, disgust, sad and surprise from 3D images in 7 yaw angles (+45° to -45°) and 3 pitch angles (+15°,0°, -15°). Most of the reported work considers + yaw angles. While in the current work, both positive as well as negative pitch and yaw angles are considered. BU3DFE database is used for the implementation. The proposed method resulted in improved accuracy and is comparable with the literature.

articleTitle: Selection of electrolyzer-fuel cell combination for supply of water and electricity in remote areas
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In the present scenario, availability of pure drinking water and electricity are the two major factors that are affecting the living conditions of the people in the developing and underdeveloped countries. In this paper, use of hydrogen for generating electrical energy with the added advantage of producing pure water is discussed. Hydrogen as an energy carrier provides as alternative way of transporting electricity, energy storage, energy generation, and pure water production. Hydrogen can be produced through the electrolysis of water, by using electricity generated from renewable sources. In this paper, fifteen commercial electrolyzers are compared on the basis of different operating parameters. Also, fifteen fuel cells are considered for comparison on the basis of different operating parameters. Electrolysis efficiency of all electrolyzers and fuel cell efficiency of all fuel cells are calculated. Electrical efficiency is calculated for the combination of top five electrolyzers with top five fuel cells and best electrolyzer-fuel cell combination is selected. The amount of water produced by fuel cells is also estimated. It can be concluded that in the order of electrolysis efficiency (energy consumption kWh/Nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), the five electrolyzer models are E1, E2, E3, E4, and E5 with E1 having maximum electrolysis efficiency or lowest energy consumption. Similarly, for the fuel cells in order of efficiency, fuel cell models are arranged as F1, F2, F3, F4, and F5 with F1 having maximum fuel cell efficiency. Electrical efficiency is calculated from electrical energy produced using different electrolyzer-fuel cell combinations for hydrogen transport distances of 100 km, 500 km, and 1000 km respectively. The highest electrical efficiency of 32.85%, 31.88%, and 30.66% are obtained for the combination E1-F1 for 100 km, 500 km, and 1,000 km distances respectively. Thus for electrolyzer-fuel cell combination, E1-F1 is found to be best for all the cases of 100 km, 500 km, and 1,000 km hydrogen transport distances respectively.

articleTitle: Mitigating sudden voltage dip in DC micro-grid using supercapacitor based energy storage system for small duration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Micro-grids have been one of the principle ways of meeting the new electricity demand in rural areas and issues already existing in the system due to the ever increasing penetration of renewable energy sources(RES) in the generation share. The challenges we face in Micro-grids due to these RES is probably not new since they also then to happen with Nonrenewable resources however the issue is the frequency of these outages or less production of power because of the intermittent nature of these RES. In this paper we will see one such issue where the power dips suddenly due to fault or decrease in generation and how supercapacitor(SC) helps in managing a constant voltage profile by supplying the necessary reactive power to the system. The simulation performed on LTSpice software doesn't consider the reason behind this decrease in power supply rather focuses only on the effect of mitigation on the voltage and power profile. The simulation results clearly show the effectiveness of using SC to take in the effects of sudden decrease in voltage which in a system purely made up of battery might have damaged the battery and also the it shows the speed at which SC can help in discharging power when needed and thus preventing unnecessary tripping of breakers or damage of electrical devices due to such voltage sags. Although a combination of battery and SC is the most ideal way of dealing with such issues of by utilizing the benefits which they give individually however in this paper only the effect of SC based system has been considered since the main aim of the paper is to show the suitability of SC in Micro-grids.

articleTitle: Novel large value grounded capacitor realizations using OTAs and small capacitors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Two novel OTA based grounded capacitor multiplier circuits are proposed. First capacitance multiplier circuit is based on OTA based impedance multiplier reported earlier. Other capacitance multiplier is an improved version of the current-mode capacitance multiplier reported earlier, where in the DO-OTA is used instead of current mirror which senses the input current and scales it by a factor (k+1) such that a scaled version of input current flows through the capacitor (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> = I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">in</sub>/(k+l)). The first capacitance multiplier uses grounded capacitor and the second one uses a floating capacitor. The capacitor multiplier circuits are verified using TINA SPICE simulator.

articleTitle: Analysis study of data buffer policies in a fuzzy logic based WSN using cluster head
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The Wireless sensor network has emerged as the new technology that will have a profound effect in all the fields being wireless in nature. Sensors are tiny nodes which have power constraints as a challenge. In this paper, we decide to conserve the energy and avoid the congestion of packets, so we have to find a route for transmission, so two cluster heads are used i.e. Secondary cluster head (SCH) and Primary cluster head (PCH) which will act as the carrier of data till the base station. One Secondary CH is chosen using fuzzy logic with the inputs which are — remaining battery, distance from node to base station and the speed of the nodes, whereas for each cluster one PCH is selected based on the distance from the center. Thus a route is found out with the SCH and PCH in the route thus conserving the energy of the nodes. The data packet delivery process is also shown in this paper with the help of two buffer policies. As each node has data packets which has different priorities (High priority & Low priority) thus the packets are being delivered by the nodes in the route also apart from the initiator, the number of type of packets to be transmitted by the nodes in the route is decided with two buffer policies, which is Single Buffer policy and Dual Buffer policy. Both the policies are analyzed and studied for a number of iterations.

articleTitle: OMLP: An efficient opportunistic multi-path routing using location and power aware method in wireless network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Routing packets along multi-path in a multi-hop wireless sensor network with many sources and destination in between, causes delay. Opportunistic routing, which considers the distance and location of the nodes is a solution for non-delay routing. Here power of the node is considered and this overcomes the deficiencies of the conventional method. By achieving the broadcast nature of wireless transmissions and the path routing overcomes the impact of poor wireless links. The results showed that in end-end delay as well as packet delivery ratio the proposed algorithm performs better than other traditional ones.

articleTitle: Cluster based fault tolerant architecture for multicasting data in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The tremendous applications of wireless sensor networks have led the way for its extensive growth and demand. The multicasting applications like streaming data/video is very challenging in wireless sensor network as they should be delivered quickly without any loss. In this paper a fault tolerant multicast routing mechanism for streaming data is proposed to achieve this goal. Sensor nodes are clustered based on location and cluster heads are responsible for delivering data to destinations. A backup cluster head is also provided in each cluster to improve the system resilience. Simulations were conducted in two scenarios one by selecting cluster heads considering node's energy and other by considering node's energy and mobility speed. Simulation results show that the latter approach achieves 11.4% decrease in end to end delay, 17.5% increase in throughput and 14.43% decrease in control overhead than former approach.

articleTitle: Estimation of garbage coverage area in water terrain
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper aim at design of computer automated garbage monitoring system in water terrain. Due to increase in the production of garbage and dumping it in the water bodies, affecting aqua animals and also human being who will either consume the water or resident around such water bodies. In this paper, authors designed an automated garbage monitoring system using image processing system. This system accepts images of water bodies and estimates the area of coverage of garbage in the specific area where garbage is accumulated and spread if any. It also notifies the percentage of garbage coverage via SMS and email so that concerned personnel can address it.

articleTitle: Evaluation of human action recognition techniques intended for video analytics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Human Action Recognition (HAR) in video plays a vital role in today's world. The aim of the HAR is to build a self-analysis system for on-going events from video data and understand the behavior of a person. This is the key functionality of intelligent video surveillance system and has wide range of applications. The applications include visual surveillance systems, robotics, health-care systems, human-computer interaction, ambient intelligence, video indexing, traffic management etc. that include interaction between humans and objects. Smart surveillance systems that can aid the human operator in real-time threat detection can be developed by applying video Analytics. Video analytics helps in interpreting the video to identify and decide spatial & temporal events not based on a one image. There are various methods to recognize actions and complex activities in a video which are reviewed in this paper. Actions are distinguished by simple motion pattern executed by a single human such as walking, running, hand-waving etc. Methods like bag of features, multiple instance markov model, MRF method are evaluated with experiments on these actions. Activities are more complex and involve harmonized actions among group of humans such as working on laptop, entering/exiting a room etc. SFG method is used with experiments on these activities. This paper collectively generalizes and interprets the various challenges, methodologies of HAR and brings out the best technique for HAR. Results of related papers are discussed elaborately with performance parameters like Precision, Recall and Accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT based automatic energy metering system with prepaid/postpaid configurability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The currently existing domestic energy meters in India had some swift technological advancements when the static meters were introduced which could calculate the power consumed without any rotary motion by using a discrete IC. This was a remarkable step in the field of electronic metering which reduced a few blemishes of the previously used dynamic meters. Despite this improvement, the procedure carried out to read the energy meters and get the billing details is done manually by an authorized member of the board at the beginning of every month. The metering we propose here automatically senses the used energy, records these readings and stores it in a cloud network where it can be monitored continuously in real time constraints. A system which will provide duteous billing info and monthly usage statistics to the user through a web server will be more suitable in the information age we are today. In addition to this, the system is made flexible by giving the user an option to renovate his conventional post-paid meter to work as a prepaid one. IOT is the technology used to make this interconnected system work in a smart and resourceful way. The system not only solves the problem of manual meter reading but also provide additional features such as power disconnection due to outstanding dues, power reconnection after making the necessary payments, power cut alert, tampering alert etc. instantly.

articleTitle: Analysis Of closed loop control of matrix converter for capacitorless single phase induction motor for variable speed operation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper deals with a newly designed matrix converter which will not only eliminate the need for external attributes required for starting single phase induction motor but also will provide a speed control feature for the motor. As it's known that to start a single phase induction motor a phase shift is required in order to produce rotating magnetic field in order to start the single phase induction motor. For this an external switch (centrifugal switch) and a capacitor is required. The need of capacitor and centrifugal switch for motor start can be eliminated through this matrix converter which will produce the 90 degree phase shift and thus eliminating the need of any external control.

articleTitle: Dual loop clock duty cycle corrector for high speed serial interface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A mixed mode Duty Cycle Corrector (DCC) with dual loop feedback for high frequency clock is proposed in this work. The proposed DCC adjusts the duty cycle of input clock by varying its rise time and fall time. The duty cycle adjuster is vital component of the circuit, which works on the principle of adjusting the pull up and pull down strength of the inverter via fed back digital signals. This circuit uses two stages of correction with first stage doing coarse correction and second stage doing fine correction. DCC is simulated in SPICE using Cadence Virtuoso in CMOS process with latest technology. The proposed DCC corrects the duty cycle of clock in the frequency range 4 to 8 GHz. The output duty cycle accuracy is 50±1% and the input duty cycle range is from 40% to 60%. It operates with a supply voltage of 1 V and dissipates 5.8 mW power at 8 GHz. The peak to peak jitter is 1.61 ps at 8 GHz. The proposed DCC is insensitive to PVT variations.

articleTitle: Comparison, simulation and hardware setup for single phase cascaded multilevel inverter with less switches
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Multilevel inverter has a purposeful applications in the domain of power electronics as it permits to reach higher voltages with low harmonics content. Rise in the number of levels, the harmonic level of output voltage will fall gradually. This paper presents two multilevel inverters, single and three phase which utilizes less switches, in the form of a small blocks coupled and cascaded together to achieve its desired output, than conventional topology, and thus there will be depletion in use of components, gate driver circuitry. A 7,9,11 level single also three phase inverter model will be simulated with the concept of SPWM techniques for the comprehensive analysis of harmonic spectrum with the usage of MATLAB/SIMULINK tool. The experimental implementation will be done for 9 level for single phase supply.

articleTitle: Crop productivity based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Since independence, India has made immense progress in the agricultural sector to meet the ever growing demands. Serious measures have to be made to increase the crop productivity as 70% of the current yield will be needed more to meet the growing population by 2050. The concept of sensing to monitor crop growth at various levels is presented in this paper. Using sensor and multispectral imaging technology, factors such as physical crop growth, nutrient and water content requirement and precise pesticides and insecticides level have been covered.

articleTitle: Indoor maps: Simulation in a virtual environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Navigating inside huge campuses can get quite cumbersome. In order to overcome this problem, Indoor mapping and modelling is introduced, which gives better sense of direction in a comparatively smaller environment. Indoor mapping and modelling includes creating an indoor environment, incorporating indoor localization techniques for tracing the user location and using a feasible way-finding algorithm for navigation in this indoor environment. This paper describes an Indoor navigation system for a college campus which uses the Global Positioning System (GPS) to create an indoor environment having Floor-wise distinction for the convenience of the user. Information acquisition was done by surveying the campus and with the help of rough floor plans (fire exit route plans) of each of the blocks. Once the information is acquired all the unessential artefacts are omitted from the acquired information.

articleTitle: Soft switching based single switch integrated converter with high voltage gain for renewable energy conversion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A novel soft switching based single switch high step-up dc-dc converter with coupled inductor and switched capacitor technique is presented in this paper. The proposed converter provides high voltage gain, high efficiency and low ripple input current suitable for renewable energy grid integration. As the voltage stress on the main switch is reduced, active switches with low conducting resistance can be used in place of the main switch. The leakage inductance snubbing effect eliminates the reverse recovery problem of switched capacitor diode. The conduction and switching losses are reduced by turning on the main switch in Zero Current Switching (ZCS) condition. The principle operation, design and analysis of the proposed soft switching based single switch integrated converter are carried out using MATLAB simulink. The comparative analysis is done with the conventional single switch converter and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Image contrast enhancement using Gaussian Mixture model and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper deals with the contrast improvement of an image so as to increase the clarity of image. The paper will adapt an image equalization technique through which an input image will be automatically enhanced with respective to contrast. The techniques we will be using are Gaussian Mixture model and Genetic Algorithm which are based on the Histogram Equalization process and measuring the intensity of spatial edges. The Histogram Equalization will focus on the enhancement of the image by changing the gray-level distribution. The Genetic Algorithm will search a best solution in the spatial domain so that it provides the image enhancement with good and natural contrast. The intersection points in the Gaussian Mixture Algorithm for the Gaussian Components are very important for the partition of dynamic range of image. The contrast is equalized and enhanced with the helping of mapping functions between input image and output image. The mapping is done for the intervals of input image by taking the gray-level distribution in to the picture. The Gaussian Mixture Model Algorithm is advantageous as it provides a better enhancement than the other state of the art algorithms. The genetic algorithm is advantageous because it does not produce unnatural brightness.

articleTitle: Estimation of Weibull parameters and wind power density at different heights for Akal site at Jaisalmer in Rajasthan
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wind resource assessment is the initial measure taken for predicting future energy production of a wind farm. The detailed analysis of variation of wind speed with height and seasons are necessary since it greatly affects the energy generation. The present paper focusses on variation of (1) Weibull parameters; (2) Mean wind speed; and (3) Wind power density with height for Akal site at Jaisalmer in Rajasthan, India. Weibull parameters at 30 m, 60 m, 90 m, and 120 m heights are estimated using measured wind data available at the respective altitudes. Weibull parameters are also calculated by using extrapolation method of Justus and Mikhail at 60 m, 90 m, and 120 m heights, considering 30 m as the reference height. Weibull parameters thus estimated by these two methods are compared for each of the heights. It is observed that the value of scale parameter increases with the height and is maximum in the month of June at all the four heights. The maximum value of shape factor is obtained in the month of September.

articleTitle: Automatic control of road traffic using video processing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Traffic Management at signals has been a major problem in India. Unscientific methods, negligence and overpopulation has led to mismanagement of traffic at traffic signals. It needs introduction of new technology and a better approach to improve the traffic condition. A possible solution to this problem is the density based automatic traffic control system. The proposed model checks for the density of traffic at the traffic signal and changes the traffic lights accordingly. A video camera and traffic lights are interfaced with Raspberry Pi board. The video is processed real time and the Raspberry Pi enables the traffic lights to change when required. This could make the movement of traffic easier and time saving. This is an improvement from the conventional timer based operation of traffic lights.

articleTitle: Reduction in carbon dioxide emissions due to wind power generation in India
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Climate change and global warming are the biggest problems mankind is facing at present. Anthropogenic generation of greenhouse gases (GHGs) and deforestation are the main reasons for these problems. In the context of India till March 31st, 2017, the share of fossil fuel (coal, gas, and diesel) based power plants is 66.79% (218.33 GW) in the 326.85 GW of total power plant installed capacity of India. The share of coal, gas, and diesel based electric power plants in total power plant installed capacity of India are 58.79%, 7.74%, and 0.26% respectively. Out of India's total renewable energy installed capacity of 57.26 GW till March 31st, 2017, wind power plant installed capacity is 32.28 GW. Thus it proves that wind power plants are the best and favorable solution in the Indian renewable energy sector till now. Wind farms have contributed a lot in CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission reduction in India. This paper is an attempt to quantify the amount of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions that are mitigated due to wind farms in India, based on the electricity generated by them and the emission factor in past eleven years from April 2006 to March 2017. CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions from fossil fuel based power plants of India are also estimated for all India and five regions namely Northern Region (NR), Eastern Region (ER), Western Region (WR), North-Eastern Region (NER), and Southern Region (SR) of India, based on the past years electricity generation data from April 2006 to March 2017.

articleTitle: Implementation of a simple point to point visible light communication system for audio and bi-directional data transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Recent developments in the LED technology have provided the potential to exploit Visible Light Communication (VLC) to a great extent. This paper presents the design of two prototypes for audio and bidirectional data transmission using VLC technology. In the prototypes, solar panel is used as the receiver.

articleTitle: Analysis of single phase matrix converter with regenerative capabilities of Single phase induction motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents the analysis of matrix converter in 1φ with regenerative operation of single phase induction motor. In the proposed topology, set of eight antiparallel power switches with diode are driven as an inverter, converter for motoring & regenerative operation. The Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) is a method that calculates the switch duty ratio to control the output voltage successfully. The mechanical torque of the motor is control by the pulse generator with the constant value. The motor feedback energy is stored by the battery with help of matrix converter. The Matrix Converter designed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The simulation results like Motoring & Regenerative, voltage, current relation are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A PFC based BLDC motor drive using buck-boost and buck-boost buck converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The usage of variable speed drive system nowadays has been increasing in many applications and to save the energy consumption of the devices, there is a necessity in the usage of green and eco-friendly electronics which led to the development of permanent magnet brushless direct current motor. This paper utilizes a BLDCM with highly reliable electrical drive where voltage source inverter feds the motor. The power factor correction circuit for dc-dc converter has been used as the VSI's precursor. The performance of the buck-boost, and buck-boost-buck converters have been analyzed to get the best suited converter from the vast class of converters. The simulation and the performance of the converter fed motor drive is studied using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Throughput optimized using evolutionary computing to guarantee QoS in IEEE 802.16 networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The rapid growth of technology and smart phone industries has led to growth of wireless communication. Recent trends show that there is increasing in network traffic due to sharing of multimedia data such as VoIP (Voice over internet protocol), video conferencing, IPTV and so on. These services require strict QoS (Quality of Service) and network resources. To cater, new network protocol such as 4G and 5G is developed. However it induces high networkdeployment cost. The Wimax 802.16 network is currently adopted by all major service providers. Therefore the Wimax network has to provision policies and QoS for varied application. However, the WiMax does not provide implementation of these QoS policies for various application needs. Various scheduling mechanism has been developed in recent time for QoS provisioning. However these models are not efficient, due to improper synchronization of users. To develop an efficient QoS provisioning model by adopting evolutionary computing for finding ideal threshold, this work presents an uplink scheduling that minimize transmission error, buffer delay for low priority connection. The experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of proposed model interm of throughput efficiency and slot utilization. The model achieves significant performance improvement over existing approach.

articleTitle: Smart school
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Education is one of the basic necessities for every individual. Running a school with all its students, parents and faculties in complete communication with each other on a single platform will be a boon for everybody associated with it. The project considers the basic and primary needs of the school. The idea of smart school helps to deal with the present problems faced in schools. The proposed project, carries out the tasks such as video surveillance, smart student attendance and marks report, smart teaching, and so on. It improves the quality of education and is efficient of time. The project is carried out using Internet of Things (IOT). Project makes use of android app which communicates with Raspberry Pi to perform above mentioned tasks. Cloud computing is used to compute the stored information and to communicate with user.

articleTitle: Multi-agent based stable clustering in VANET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) is part of Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) that facilitates communication between group of vehicles to provide driver safety, traffic updates, entertainment, data sharing etc. Clustering is an efficient method to handle the frequent change in the topology of VANET by means of local co-ordination. We present multi agent based stable clustering to provide stability, which in turn enhance the cluster life time. Proposed approach make use of multi-agent interaction method consists of static and mobile agents to establish the communication between vehicles and RSU. RSU agent responsible to decide the cluster size and select the suitable cluster head based on vehicle speed and connectivity with neighboring nodes. Here we vary the cluster size depending upon vehicle speed, which in turn increases the cluster life time and reduces the routing overhead. After formation of cluster maintenance of cluster is hand over to cluster head agent. The proposed method is simulated in NS2 by considering some of the performance parameters such as vehicle speed, node density, cluster formation time, cluster head selection time, communication range etc.

articleTitle: An approach for indoor location estimation to the visually challenged using light fidelity (Li-Fi) technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Indoor navigation is favorable for every person, and is exclusively essential for the visually challenged. The proposed method uses Light-Fidelity (Li-Fi) technology for transmission of the information. Li-Fi is apt for high-density wireless data exposure in restrained regions that are free of hindrances. Li-Fi is a progressing branch of Optical Wireless Communication and can give greater data rate transmission laterally with the proficiency to employ surplus users since it uses a spectrum bandwidth of wider-range.

articleTitle: Design of low error fractional order IIR digital differentiators and integrators
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this paper, linear phase wideband IIR fractional order digital differentiators (FODDs) and integrators (FODIs) are designed using Genetic Algorithm (GA) optimization tool and binomial expansion. The proposed fourth order differentiators and integrators are stable and highly approximate the ideal ones in terms of the magnitude response where percentage relative error is taken as the criteria for defining the accuracy of the system. The design also gives linear phase response which is better than the existing ones.

articleTitle: A double negative metamaterial antenna for WiMAX application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A compact Double Negative (DNG) metamaterial antenna is presented in this research. The antenna has a volume of 0.33λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.27λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.01λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> at lower resonance of 3.3 GHz. The extraction method of permeability and permittivity of the metamaterial circular split ring resonator (SRR) through waveguide medium is discussed in detail. The antenna operates at 3.3 GHz with S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> < −10 dB bandwidth of about 5.45 % (3.21–3.39 GHz). Stable radiation characteristics, good impedance matching and VSWR < 2 is obtained for the proposed design. The proposed metamaterial antenna is intended for the use of WiMAX application (3.3 GHz).

articleTitle: Use of roof top ventilator for electricity generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative method of generating electricity from the energy possessed by wind by virtue of its motion. The prototype is developed by insulating each fin from other fins and rest of the structure and by adding the assembly needed to provide magnetic flux and to collect generated current in the existing roof top ventilator. These changes are done on the most commercially used and readily available roof top ventilator. This paper mainly deals with the design and construction of the model. The concept resembles with four pole DC generator except, in the proposed model rotor is outside and stator is inside unlike the DC generator. Another noteworthy point about this model is that fins of ventilator fan are used as conductors forming rotor part and electromagnets are placed on additional stationary frame forming stator part. This modified system managed to get output around 1-2 volts. Implementation of such models, connected in series and parallel, is preferred to get sufficient output to charge a battery so that stored energy can be used for lighting purposes. Ventilation and lighting, both purposes are served by this model simultaneously which is important for improving working conditions of employees in the factory. Such eco-friendly models are recommended for upcoming factories in order to mitigate the effects of vitiated atmosphere because of lack of ventilation and lighting.

articleTitle: Methodology using OBIST for detecting parametric with single and multiple catastrophic faults in an analog integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A technique for fault diagnosis using oscillation based built-in self-test (OBIST) is presented in this paper. The method is used to detect parametric, single as well as multiple catastrophic faults in analog circuits of mixed signal IC. In this method the circuit under test (CUT) is converted to an oscillator and the output pulses are measured to test the circuit. For most of the catastrophic faults the variation in number of pulses is large and they are detected easily. The pulses are counted for lesser time to detect these faults. If catastrophic faults are present the chip is rejected without checking for parametric faults. Upon passing catastrophic fault test, the chip has to undergo rigorous process of testing parametric faults. Usefulness of this method is verified for various active filters and simulation results on second order Butterworth low pass filter (LPF) circuits with cutoff frequencies 10-50 kHz in the steps of 10 kHz are discussed.

articleTitle: Hybridization of B-tree and HashMap for optimized search engine indexing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Performance of a Search engines depend on indexing schemes for fast retrieval of results. Hash Map based indexing schemes is one the most popular indexing scheme. Although it has a good best case performance, it has poor performance with increase in number of documents as many keys hash to the same value and the search complexity rises [4]. A balanced multi-way B-tree based solution is used as an attempt to find whether document contains search word and then Hash Map is used to retrieve the occurrence of the word in a document. It reduces the number of look ups on Hash Map. The advantages of both the algorithms are combined to produce faster results in constant time; Ranking of web pages is done by analyzing the content. The document containing higher frequency of occurrence of query word is listed on top and the decreasing order of results is displayed. The proposed solution provides a logarithmic retrieval time even with increasing number of documents.

articleTitle: Detection of unusual events in low resolution video for enhancing ATM security and prevention of thefts
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In present-day applications, tracking object in low resolution video is a stimulating task due to loss of distinctive aspect in the visual outward look of moving target object. The present-day approaches are typically involved on the enhancement of Low Resolution (LR) video by super resolution techniques. However these approaches need massive computational cost. This cost again rises if we are handling with event detection. Recently, an algorithm has been developed which is capable of detecting unusual events and for enhancement of ATMs security where simple low resolution cameras are used because of their lower cost. Our state-of-the-art technique is able to detect the existence of unusual events like face masking, camera masking, fight or overcrowding in the low resolution video merely by means of standard deviation, statistical method of moving target objects. It is sufficient because it processes low resolution frames and also sends alert messages to the concerned authorities in investigation (surveillance) system for enhancing the ATMs security and prevention of thefts using conventional camera of low resolution.

articleTitle: Design of sign language system; using APR9600 and glove technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A different language is a different vision of life. The progression in implanted framework, gives a space to outline and build up a communication via sound interpreter framework to help the handicapped individuals. This paper mostly delivers to encourage handicapped individual's way of life. Average folks additionally confront hard to comprehend the motion dialect. To defeat these constant issues, this framework is produced. At whatever point the proposed framework detects any gesture based communication, it plays relating recorded voice. This diminishes the correspondence hole among handicapped and common individuals. This proposed display comprise of 4 concepts, detecting unit, preparing unit, voice stockpiling unit and remote correspondence unit. It is accomplished by incorporating flex sensor and APR9600 with LM386. The flex sensors are set in gloves, which react to signal. By utilizing appropriate circuit reaction of the sensor is given to the microcontroller in light of the reaction microcontroller plays the recorded voice utilizing APR9600. A preview of the whole framework, advantage over existing strategies and reenactment yield of the procedure is talked about in this work. This framework offers high dependability and quick reaction. This technique is more exact available development and diverse dialects can be introduced without changing the code in PIC microcontroller. No one is as handicapped as the man who will not listen. Imagine-Invent-Inspire.

Author Keywords: IC(HT-12E, HT-12D) RF Module(Transmitter and Receiver)

articleTitle: Evaluation of the performance metrics of a 4 bit universal shift register and its implementation in an arithmetic & logic unit
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Sequential Circuits are extensively used in the design of memory elements such as flip-flops and registers. Registers are used as data storage devices in low power VLSI designs. A Universal Shift Register (USR) is a type of register which is a combination of unidirectional, bidirectional and parallel loading register. The mode of operation switches with the select lines of the design. The design and testing of the Universal Shift Register has been carried out in Cadence Virtuoso tool. The technology file used is gpdk045 i.e. the circuit was designed in 45nm technology regime. The aim of this paper is to evaluate and analyze the performance parameters of the USR so that it can further be utilized in complex VLSI designs to achieve better performance. In this paper, we have done a complete analyses of the performance parameters, such as Power, Speed, PDP and EDP. The design style used is the complementary static CMOS design style due to its robustness, high immunity to noise, lower static power dissipation, high degree of automation, hassle free design process and it is amenable to voltage scaling.

articleTitle: A hierarchical finger selection method for finger vein recognition using sift
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Finger vein has currently observed as an competent biometric strategy. In this paper, we proposed a hierarchical preferred finger authentication using finger vein, which is main source over the traditional score-level fusion methods. In this proposed technique, initially we consider feature extraction of the 6 fingers of center, and ring finger for both right and left hand as the essential feature for finger vein recognition and then a new verdict rule is defined based on the sift algorithm. Finally, we find that the finger will provide maximum number robust feature of points for the matching algorithm. Considerable experiments are conducted to evaluate using SIFT algorithm and results of conducted experiments show that it can achieve a favorable performance.

articleTitle: Hyper-chaos encryption application in intelligent home system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Intelligent home products have serious information security risks, threatening the privacy of users. In this paper, a method of password protection using hyper-chaos based one-way hash function and secure information transmission method based on spatiotemporal chaos are proposed. The proposed method creates a unidirectional hash function using the delay induced hyper-chaotic system and the key stream iteration to protect user password and to realize user authentication. At the same time, the chaotic time series generated by the one way coupled map lattice system is used to encrypt the plaintext information for the data secure communication, which increases the security of the intelligent home system. An intelligent home system prototype is built based on a Zigbee network, cloud server, and Android system.

articleTitle: Dynamic power factor regulation using thyristor switched capacitor for industrial loads
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The obligation to comply to power factor limits has driven consumers to adopt reactive power compensation techniques for the loads. The advancements in solid state switches have paved way for replacement of automatic power factor correction units with solid state switch based compensation. Even then, Thyristor switched capacitor (TSC) based power factor compensation used in industries are very few, owing to their higher cost. However, understanding and incorporating the requirements and conditions for effective operation of TSC power factor compensation is necessary to achieve maximum payback. The results of an attempt to study and simulate the TSC for a group of induction motors is presented in this paper. The study shows the superiority of performance of TSC in respect of accuracy in achieving the desired power factor in comparison with Fixed capacitor compensation.

articleTitle: Price negotiation for cloud resource provisioning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Cloud technology adopts pay per use based model to offer various services to its users. It provides resources and/or services dynamically on demand basis, to meet the requirements of multiple users concurrently. The cloud users and service providers belonging to different administrative domains have different preferences, objectives, requirements and policies to either access and provide various services. The cloud users prefer services to be obtained at a reasonable cost, while service providers prefer effective service provisioning and increase cloud resource utilization. Thus there is a need for users to negotiate price with service providers for their service. Though there exists many mechanisms for price negotiation in the literature, game theory based mechanisms have a wider scope to apply for the cloud environment. Hence in this paper game theory based non-cooperative bargaining protocol is designed to negotiate the resource price, which will aid consumers and providers to increase their profit and resource utilization. The work is simulated using MATLAB on a Pentium machine. Results show that the offered price varies with negotiation time, consequently leading to varied surplus/profit to both consumers and providers.

articleTitle: Fault tolerance in VANET's
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In VANET communication is one of the important concepts. Vehicular communication is defined as the conversation between two vehicles. Conservation in between the vehicles makes an accident free domain. As the pristine technologies are evolved and pristine applications emerging, so new fault tolerance methods are needed. In this technology many faults are arises due to mobility, software and hardware failures. To vanquish such type of faults this paper presents “Fault tolerance in VANET's”. The main goal of this paper is to detect and recovery the faults by using detectors and choose best nodes through which information can be transferred. The proposed model is simulated in NS-2 simulator to examine the potency of this scheme. To evaluate the performance of the proposed system some of the parameters considered are throughput, packet delivery ratio and packet drop.

articleTitle: A novel UE centric multi-RAT deployment model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Today's User Equipment (UE) is enabled with multiple Radio Access Technologies (multi-RAT), e.g., GSM, UMTS, LTE, WLAN etc., to support ubiquitous and mobile computing. So, a key feature of UE is to support multi-RAT mobility procedures, whose performances need to be carefully evaluated. For this purpose, a multi-RAT deployment model, as experienced by the UE would be useful. To the best of our knowledge, existing methods/models for this purpose are network centric and/or have shortcomings, like cost, scalability and inability to mimic a real multi-RAT deployment, which is based on operator's business needs. We propose a novel UE centric multi-RAT deployment model combining business requirements of network operator (modeled with Analytical Hierarchical Process) and technical aspect of RATs, e.g., received signal strength, path loss, etc. (using radio propagation models). Simulation results illustrate how RAT selection, multi-RAT mobility and call success/drop procedures in a UE can be evaluated using our model. One of the results show for a UE attempting calls, the percentages of call success is 83%, overall call drops is 16% and only multi-RAT call drops is 1%.

articleTitle: An improved publish-subscribe method in application layer protocol for IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is a collection of smart devices which communicate with each other to accomplish task or provide any particular service. Machine to Machine (M2M) communication is more in IoT than normal internet. The Internet provides services when any person requests it. In case of IoT, smart devices have to provide services continuously by realizing requirement of a person without disturbing him. To accomplish this task, IoT devices need to share information with each other as soon as it updates. In such condition, request-response technique creates overhead on the system. So publish-subscribe technique is used to get an immediate response as soon as data changes. Service consumer or subscriber needs to send a request for particular service to the broker. The broker will maintain the list of the subscriber and will forward data to all subscribers as it updates. But this broker creates single point bottleneck in publish-subscribe communication. In this report, distributed publish-subscribe techniques has been proposed which will distribute publishers and subscribers on the different brokers removing single point bottleneck. It will also distribute the load of brokers and improve the availability of service.

articleTitle: A study of scheduler performance analysis in spark enabled GPU cluster
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Apache Spark is an open source cluster computing framework used for big data processing. Apache Spark works efficiently for processing large amounts of data than a Map reduce program. Apache Spark applications run programs 100 times faster than Hadoop in memory. The performance of the Spark applications is further increased using the GPU integration. The schedulers also play a vital role in the performance. This work focuses on the performance analysis of the current schedulers of Spark enabled GPU cluster.

articleTitle: Automatic document retrieval using SVM machine learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper describes a classifier based automatic document retrieval system for accurately retrieving relevant documents and assigning them to proper workflow in the application. Documents present in archives oftentimes become illegible or distorted with time. Hence the system will first be used to recognize those distorted characters and then document text classification will be done using supervised machine learning. Language specific post-processing is not used by the system for obtaining this performance. It can also adapt to new fonts, styles and collections. The given system achieves an efficiency of up to 94% for character recognition and 97% for document classification.

articleTitle: A low power asynchronous Viterbi decoder using minimum transition hybrid register exchange method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Todays world is digital and therefore digital communication plays a vital role in communication systems. Viterbi algorithm invented by Andrew J. Viterbi is widely used for error correction of communication devices. Due to the high performance, Viterbi Decoder is broadly used to decode the convolutional codes. One third area is occupied by Viterbi decoders while chip manufacturing. A lot many researches were carried out at architectural as well as algorithmic level to optimize the ACS (Add compare and Select) unit and Survival Memory Management in Synchronous Viterbi Decoders. But still there is a problem of power dissipation which requires more technical solutions. Due to requirements of high speed, low power low weight and long battery life a low power Viterbi decoders has a great demand in the communication field. This paper proposed three methods for survivor path storage and decoding as Register Exchange Method (REM), Hybrid Register Exchange Method (HREM) and Minimum Transition Hybrid Register Exchange Method (MTHREM). But as we designed and simulate the Viterbi decoder using above mentioned methods we observed that the REM consumes more power and area as it gives high switching activity. We combines the two techniques as Traceback and REM called HREM for further reduction in switching activity at every cycle. Both the methods has their own drawbacks. To reduce power by controlling α switching activity and also the unwanted transitions from one register to other at every time interval we introduced the new techniques called MTHREM. Viterbi decoders designed using REM, HREM and MTHREM is simulated and power is calculated using Power play power analyzer. As the switching activity is reduced in MTHREM as compared to REM and HREM the Viterbi decoder achieves reduction in power in MHREM as compared to REM and HREM. For further reduction in power of Viterbi decoder we proposed asynchronous techniques like Handshaking protocol. Here we designed the Asynchronous Viterbi decoder by using Level encoded dual rail encoding (LEDR).

articleTitle: ASIC implementation of switch architecture used in NoC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: For large system designs the Bus topology has the several limitations from the physical design viewpoint. The wire occupy much area of the chip and in the nanometer CMOS technology, interconnects dominates both the performance and dynamic power dissipation. Bus topology is not scalable and system throughput is also low, so Network on Chip (NoC) is desirable to interconnect the IP's in chip. NoC refers to the on chip interconnections among the various IP's present in a system-on-chip (SoC). NoC uses packets to route the data from the source to the destination, via the network that consist of crossbar switches, buffers, arbiter and interconnection links. In NoC switching strategy determines flow of data through routers in network and routing algorithm is responsible for routing data from source to destination. In this paper the NoC switch architecture is proposed by using static routing algorithm for mesh topology network.

articleTitle: CareBot: The automated caretaker system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: OpenCV is a growing technology, and it has the potential to replace the current technologies used in security systems, space applications, hospitals etc. This paper proposes the use of OpenCV's image-processing feature embedded in an automated robot, which can be used in hospitals and such. Hospitals often require the monitoring of patients at regular intervals, coupled with administering the prescribed medications according to a particular schedule. The proposed robot system can be significantly helpful at hospitals where the number of nurses are not enough to take care of all the patients. Owing to people's forgetfulness due to age and other aspects, they may miss their medication meant to be taken at a specific time. This delay can further deteriorate the health of the patient. The automated robot system analyses the position of each bed and matches the medicine intake using image-processing concepts, ensuring that the patient takes his/her dosage according to the schedule specified by the doctor.

articleTitle: Current-mode filter structure using DO-OTA with dual current outputs Io and Io/n for low-frequency applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents the operational transconductance amplifier and capacitor (OTA-C) current-mode filter structures using DO-OTA with dual current outputs I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub>/n (n>l) for low frequency applications which can be used to design for desired pole-Q without sacrificing the gain.
