Larger time constants are shown to be achieved by scaling feedback current(s) but without using components in the feedback network. The filter structures offer independent tunabilty of pole-Q. The use of these filter structures for low frequency applications is verified using TINA-TI circuit simulator.

articleTitle: Analysis and comparison of transmit diversity scheme using MRC and EGC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: MIMO systems have become fundamental part of present day communication framework. The main issues that arise in cellular structures are to provide proper administration to clients, communication without fading and interference, to increase the capacity and data rates, expand the limit of the cell with minimum bit error ratio and signal-noise ratio for which we use equal gain combiner (EGC). EGC system reduces to MRC as show closer error performance where MRC measures signal phase and amplitude.

articleTitle: Digital technology in classroom: Changing the face of education infographic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Through this paper of mine I would like to elaborate the usage of Digital Technology in classrooms. In many countries teachers as well as students are allowed to use the newly introduced devices like iPad, Tabs, Minis and etc with WiFi connectivity at the school levels. In India still we are struggling with the old anomalies of not even using the electronic devices which are generally used in terms of technology advancement. The usage of such devices at the school level can help and provide the knowledge to students to compete in the technology world. These devices are capable enough to become the guide and the mentor to make students techno savvy which will play a vital role in making the education system fully ICT based at school levels.

articleTitle: Digitized ECG image analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is the study of recording of electrical activity of heart. The study of ECG paper images identifies and understands the condition of the heart. An automatic system convert digital electrocardiography (ECG) information from images into digital ECG signals using MATLAB. We develop a method that involves scan the ECG images then convert to get computerized ECG signal using digital image processing techniques.

articleTitle: Graphical password scheme using persuasive cued click points
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents a security scheme with the help of Graphical Password which uses images. The main goal of this project is to support the users in selecting better and safe passwords. The user will click on a particular part of the image to confirm authentication. The persuasive cued clicked points will provide a series of images so that security increases as it will give a workload for the intruders. The series of images will be provided based on the previous click on the image. The psychological study reveals that a person can remember a visual image more than the series of alpha-numeric characters. So remembering the points on the images for a user will be easy and will be difficult for an intruder to get access. The persuasive cued clicks help the users to choose more random positions for the increase of security. The advantages of the Graphical Password Scheme are the easy usability and greater security.

articleTitle: Communication by terrorist using access points: Cyber security
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Currently, new advancement in the technologies have brought many facilities to the people. With this advancement criminal activity has also been facilitated as communication pattern have changed. At the same time technological advancement has also made it possible for law enforcing agencies to decipher, trace & understand the pattern of communication between criminals. Recent development of Wi-Fi infrastructures and increasing use of wireless communication has given birth to new issues challenges for these law enforcers.

articleTitle: A novel approach to human gesture recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Gesture recognition with its many possible applications in fields like surveillance, human computer interaction etc. has become an important topic in research today. It is difficult to achieve high accuracies in real scenarios due to the large number of human gestures present, the possibility of noise in the video etc. In this paper, a new method of gesture recognition is proposed, that includes foreground detection, detection of the human figures, and gesture recognition. Several techniques for preprocessing such as Canny Edge Detector, Gabor filter, and Otsu thresholding have been compared, and the results are discussed. In general Gabor filter finally gave better results for gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Vertical transportation: An overview on system integration with advance technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Configurations are experimented that is proposed to examine the interactive assessment of the system integration with permanent magnet machines adopted for vertical transportation. Various combinations have been proposed and understood with tangible measurements and scrutinize the behavior with flexible load on the system that would be proposed for a superior and effective safety system Various performance parameters on system level have been deliberated with different dynamic loading conditions on the vertical transportation traction systems capturing tangible measurements and examine the loading pattern of the system, which would enhance and give us opportunity for selection of optimum system integration but not compromising on key factors like quality, cost, reliability and robustness factors. A case study is proposed to be conducted with adjustable speed drives along with permanent magnet synchronous machines to easily adopt for the society with new technology that would contribute energy savings as a main factor, which is very dire issue for the developing countries.

articleTitle: Normalization method for misaligned face samples in non-cooperative biometrics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Reliability and robustness of a verification system is a major concern in biometrics. One of the most important covariates in face non-cooperative biometrics is misalignment, which exist because of errors in face detector. Current research is happening in this direction in order to make non-cooperative biometrics more reliable and consistent. In this paper, we have proposed the face normalization method to overcome the negative effects of misalignment. This method is based on first determining the eye distance and then determining the face which depend on the location of eyes. With this method, the recognition accuracy increases significantly from 44.95% to 66.66 %. It is worth mentioning that the experiments were conducted on the dataset, where large variations of poses, scales and illumination exists and these characteristics makes this dataset more appropriate for doing validation for non-cooperative face biometrics. However, detection rate with eye detector will be smaller than that of face detector. Thus, it's essential to make eye detector more reliable and robust in non-cooperative face biometrics.

articleTitle: Location based hybrid spectrum sensing and power allocation in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this paper we consider a two level sensing in hybrid overlay/underlay non cooperative cognitive radio networks. For initial phase sensing energy detection is used to identify channel state (idle or busy) and then transmit power is set accordingly (overlay/underlay). During the transmission phase of secondary user (SU) a two level sensing is carried out. The first level detects interference and second level identifies source of interference using Direction of Arrival (DOA) detection schemes and underlay transmission is carried out if signal is found to be from Primary User(PU). This approach isolates the interference due to PU from the interference due to miss detection from another SU or from malicious user. Further due to two level detection the probability of detection is considerably increased. Based on the detection outcome channel occupancy is decided. The proposed multilevel sensing and power allocation algorithm is analyzed theoretically. The performance of proposed scheme is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Database-per-service for e-learning system with micro-service architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Smart education with cutting edge technology is trending in Ε-Learning platform. The design of e-learning system exists with lot of challenges and need for a strong, flexible and robust system which is available to users. Database-per-service is a performance oriented cloud based service model, provides flexible access to users anywhere-anytime without setting up any physical hardware or setting any software configuration. In our proposed work we come across some of the features to meet setting up the e-learning system considerations are; large amount of data, multi users, and specific user access (privacy) with flexibility. Monolithic architecture based applications are currently in the market, but facing lot of drawbacks with respect to maintenance, scaling up and flexibility of use. We propose a micro-service based architecture for an e-learning platform using database-per-service and solve problems faced working under monolithic architecture to make more flexible. Implementation carried out by designing an e-learning architecture, each topic under a course is divided into micro-topics and micro-service architecture built with database-per-service plugin for each service which is independent of service. Each micro-service is flexible to communicate with other micro-service and achieved performance enhancement in data management and usability.

articleTitle: Abstraction of information flow and functional dependency from a restructured legacy ‘C’ program for parallelization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The prologue of multicore architectures in the hardware computation industry has crafted significant challenge to the software industry working with single core sequential programs. Realizing the total potentiality of the multicore requires redefining software programming by initializing parallelization with decomposition of the software into functional modules amenable for multicore through parallel execution. The paper proposes a methodology which considers restructured legacy ‘C’ program as input and abstracts the complete design information (control and data) in the form of Information Flow Table (IFT). The IFT tabulates the ordered sequential flow of control and data along the program. The abstracted IFT is further used for analyzing the inter and intra control and data flow dependency amongst the computational units of the program, and realize the relations depicting the control and data dependency and capture the data influencing the behavior of the computational unit along its flow. These functional dependency relations further provide scope for the abstraction of functionality from the legacy program, inducing parallelization.

Author Keywords: Explicit and Implicit Intra control dependency

articleTitle: Pre-processing of user behaviour for e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In today's highly used internet considering approximately 205 million online shoppers each day, entrepreneurs are falling into online business. Hence to draw attention to a e-commerce store, Online Advertising is one of the best ways to reach new leads. Recommendation system have attracted nowadays in the field of web application systems and online information retrieval. These systems are applied in various domains such as movies, news, and online e-commerce. For better online e-commerce, personal recommendation is very important. In this paper, we focus on pre-processing of the user behaviour towards products which is the first step for designing a good personal recommendation system. The proposed work which consists of 4 steps: Data Collection, pre-processing, statistical analysis of the user's behaviour to predict user's interest based on their order history and Summarization.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of microstrip patch antenna using plywood as substrate for fixed satellite and earth exploration applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A rectangular microstrip patch antenna employing wood as substrate has been propounded in this paper. A piece of wood having the dielectric constant of εr=4.1 and thickness of 4.8 mm has been designed as the dielectric material between the radiating patch and ground. The copper having thickness of 0.25 mm has been used for the purpose of designing the patch, ground and feed line. Various feeding techniques has been used to feed the microstrip patch antenna and width of feed line has been set nearly across 50 Ω for impedance matching and minimum reflection losses. Various antenna characteristics like gain (dB), directivity (dBi), HPBW, return loss (dB), impedance (ohms) has been analyzed and the value of VSWR should be less than 2 corresponding to its resonant frequency which is the maximum acceptable value of VSWR. CST Microwave Studio 2016 has been used for the simulation of antenna delineation. E5071C Network Analyzer and Anechoic Chamber has been used for the pragmatically fabrication and testing of propounded antenna. It has been analyzed that simulated results closely match with pragmatic result.

articleTitle: Shuffle-selective search
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: There are scenarios when one need to find the key element in a set of data, where the key element's presence can be felt but the literal position is the hindrance. In deactivating the intrusion effect on the system where a bulk of nodes is connected, finding the exact node within the network will be the solid challenge. The Shuffle-Selective Search could ease the job.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of current-fed impulse commutated three-phase push-pull DC/DC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents the performance analysis of current fed push-pull dc/dc converter based on ZCS with impulse commutation. The basic problem of conventional current fed converter is turn off spikes. This problem has been solved by impulse commutation. For zero current operation of devices with impulse commutation the resonance is achieved between leakage inductances and parallel capacitors reduces the components of circuit and provide low circulating current. The simulation results using MATLAB 2015b have been obtained for input, switches, inductances, capacitors, diodes, and output.

articleTitle: An IOT based network management system for enterprise network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The way enterprises conducting business over the internet is evolving. Virtualization, cloud computing and Software-defined networking (SDN) are server based tools that help amplify the growth of organizations. Uninterrupted power and efficient management of it is a fundamental requirement for the technologies to function satisfactorily. On the other power outage is a reality. Hence addressing power issues for a server is a vital factor in its management. The monitoring system simulates various tasks of an administrator in real time, and request administrators support for tasks beyond its scope. By integrating necessary features into the Network Operations Center (NOC) monitoring system for its optimum automated operations results in ensuring limited administrators monitoring time for a single NOC. The intent of the proposed work is to augment human resource deployed into single NOC to multiple NOC. The focal point of the monitoring system is to assist the network administrator in network troubleshooting, resource management, performance monitoring, and coordination with affiliated networks. The tool proposed also incorporates necessary alerting or warning mechanism based on the severity of issue detected forthwith.

articleTitle: Improved security in audio steganography using packet forger at the third level
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Security is the most important factor to be considered when there is communication between the two entities. Cryptographic techniques take data as input and metamorphose it into content which is obscure. Steganographic techniques take data as input and place it in multimedia such as interactive content, animation, text, still images, audio and video footage. Audio Steganography takes text data as input along with an audio file and modifies this audio by embedding the text data. Least Significant Bit (LSB) is taken from byte array of audio and text data represented in binary is placed here. This is vulnerable to attacks and a very strong mechanism is preferred against attacks. Packet Forger generates multiple packets with scrambled and modified encrypted content present in all of these packets. This confuses the attacker and hence provides an additional level of security. Hence, a system which uses security across three layers is proposed.

articleTitle: A back-propagation neural network based method for post life expectancy estimation of thoracic surgery patients
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper proposes a life expectancy estimation method after thoracic surgery. It determines whether the person will live more than 1 year or not. A neural network called feed forward back-propagation neural network is used for estimation purpose. Test samples collected from diagnosis are given as input to the neural network classifier for estimation of life expectancy. Accuracy of the proposed method is 94.3% for all the tested samples. Hence the proposed method can be used efficiently for monitoring the thoracic surgery patients.

articleTitle: Cluster based context aware secure routing in distributed sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Distributed Sensor Network (DSN) built with smart sensor nodes by high computing network. A DSN has been attractive platform for researchers from many years and it's to provide effective computing and making secure communication or routing between source and sink node. However, sensor networks are vulnerable in an environment with respect to attacks. This paper proposes a cluster based context ware secure routing in DSN by employing Grid Based cluster approach. This approach incorporates efficient cluster head selections, context discovery, context interpretation, and secure routing mechanisms in DSNs. The objective of the proposed work is to improve the effective performance of networks. The proposed work had been simulated in terms of packet delivery ratio, network lifetime, energy consumption, throughput, and packet dropping ratio.

articleTitle: Real time traffic speed controlling, collision detection and vehicle tracking system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In the recent decade transportation become more important in developed countries due to growth of population. In this paper we present the two systems which reduce the death caused due to accident. A vibration detector, GPS module and ARM are used to detect the accident location, and send the message to pre-programmed number by GSM module. By using RF signal the speed of the vehicle is controlled under the speed limiting zones.

articleTitle: Implementation the layout of an aerial robocopter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The aim of this research is to develop a compact and cost effective robocopter that will be capable of military research and rescue operations. While designing robocopter we use 1400 kv brushless motors, 60A Electronic Speed Controller set, 1080HD surveillance Camera, 500 MHz Wireless Receiver, Military Server, Lithium-ion Battery, 2 axis robot arm, Heatshrink Tube. For stability and light weight robocopter is made up of carbon nano fiber.

articleTitle: Analysis of amplitude and phase imbalances on efficiency of microwave power combiner
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this paper a detailed analysis of power combining efficiency for a generic 2" way power combiner is carried out. The analysis includes the impact of amplitude and phase imbalances in reducing the efficiency in-addition to insertion loss. The findings aid in estimating the efficiency of a generic 2" way power combiner using 2 way as a basic unit. Furthermore, the findings can also be used to derive realistic specifications for a generic 2" way power combiner. As a rule of thumb to achieve 99 % efficiency in an ideal 2 way power combiner, phase imbalance should be within 11 deg (assuming zero amplitude imbalance) where as amplitude imbalance should be within 1.7 dB (assuming zero phase imbalance).

articleTitle: An analytical model for long channel Double Gate Ge Ferroelectric FET (DGGeFeFET) to study the impact of interface trap charges
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In this work, an analytical model has been proposed to incorporate the advantages of ferroelectric gate insulator and Germanium as channel material. A 1-D analytical model for long channel Double Gate Ge Ferroelectric Field Effect Transistor has been developed using Poisson's equation and Landau-Khalatnikov equation. It has been demonstrated that the proposed device exhibits step up voltage conversion capability, improved transport efficiency and reduced subthreshold swing values which makes it suitable for low power/low voltage applications. Also, the effect of interface trap charge density on device performance has been examined and it has been shown that presence of trap charge degrades device characteristics.

Author Keywords: high carrier mobility and voltage amplification

articleTitle: Test coverage optimization in LBIST
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The major disadvantage with LBIST is the test coverage in many cases is about 25% less compared to that of ATPG test coverage. The paper focuses on study of various coverage limitations of LBIST and provides solutions to overcome these coverage limitations to make the test coverage of LBIST closer to ATPG. Resolving the X sources by different X bounding techniques leads the interfacing logic of the core untested by LBIST. The X sources between cores/partitions can be solved by introducing an additional LBIST for wrapper chains of cores there by achieving an additional test coverage of 22.96% on untested paths in EXTEST mode of top level LBIST.

articleTitle: Comb needle model for data aggregation using self-diagnose cluster in WSN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In Various situations, the emerging application is wireless sensor network in research area. The basic technique in WSN is data aggregation, for an application the aggregation is take place such as monitoring the environmental condition. Data aggregation is effective technique in terms of energy and time of data collection. In this paper, we discuss about the data get aggregate by cluster head in cluster for consumption of energy, enhancing battery and life time networking. And we use self-diagnose of Cluster Head (CH).

articleTitle: Artificial neural networks vs regression techniques in the forecasting of contaminants in the Santiago River, based on the sample of a pollutant, through Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The present article shows a comparison of the use of both Neuronal Networks and Regression methods in the pollutant forecast in the Santiago River, analyzing data obtained from previous samples by data fusion and considering a base pollutant to predict the relationship with more pollutants present in the river, avoiding the detailed and particular tests of the other Contaminants. This paper determines how to choose the best algorithm of the both, based on the error forecast.

articleTitle: Optimization of energy storage elements in a cross-connected capacitors boost converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A cross-connected capacitors boost converter is presented in this paper, which is more advantageous than conventional boost converter. This boost converter offers high voltage gain with low ripple content. Initially steady-state analysis and state-space models of the cross-connected capacitors boost converter are established and analyzed leading to transfer function formulation. Further the optimized design values for the energy storage elements of the converter was explored. The design values of the energy storage components are optimized using the MATLAB optimization toolbox with `fgoalattain' solver to reduce the up-down glitch in the higher order converter. This problem normally occurs in the higher order converters because of the presence of complex poles and zeroes in their transfer functions. In the transfer function the origin of an up-down glitch is realized and its effect on the system performance is also discussed. Here 12 V, 25 W converter is examined and the results are obtained. Later, the obtained results are compared with the optimized results through simulation.

articleTitle: Enhanced security protocol for mobile computation offloading and accessing data offline
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Primary concern for majority of users in the world has been low battery life. A survey conducted in 2005 found users from around 15 countries to have battery life of a mobile to be the top most priority. Mobile systems nowadays have plenty of features such as wide range network bandwidth, increased processor performance and enhanced storage capacity which eventually leads to lower battery life. A better way to accommodate a larger battery can be achieved with the help of computation offloading. It allows to shift our storage and computation over cloud thus leading the designers to accommodate a larger battery life. Offloading computation can be done in variety of ways like cluster, grid or cloud. Uploading your entire data over cloud has only one disadvantage that we won't be able to access data while being offline. This paper will be focussing on how to access data without internet and providing enhanced security protocols for content over cloud.

articleTitle: Smart billing system framework for economic internet connectivity
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internet is the one of the key player in the World's Economic development. Many organizational businesses depend on Internet Connectivity. This paper gives the framework to implement Bill on the service network. Many researchers have presented their thoughts on billing internet services but implementation or framework of this ideology is not concrete. In this paper, we have attempted to give a frame work model which suites for the scenarios for the corporate world to the local user. This framework is simulated as scenario on QualNet HSRP model based on RFC 2281. The concepts such Multihoming, Overlay architecture with Optimal multipath routing policy forms the new method known as smart billing system with cost effectiveness services for clients. The results presented are on the present existing IPv4 Infrastructure Network type and also implemented for IPv6 based network to present advanced next generation network which is the need of the day. Overall, this paper gives an over view of present day technology and the billing strategies for the enterprise network.

articleTitle: Revised Petri net: Probabilistic approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In present world telemedicine has revolutionized the health care system up to a certain level. But there are some limitations which we need to overcome for providing an easy to avail health-care system for the common people. Keeping that fact in mind, later Multi Agent System (MAS) was introduced in health-care system. In our previous research paper, we proposed Intelligent Treatment coordination system “Treatment as a Service” or “TaaS”. It is a Multi Agent based health care system for the people at home and specially for the hospitalized patient where the people can be treated with the help of multiple agents, without much intervention of the human-being. In this paper, we first describe the concept of “TaaS” and then analyzed the performance of each transaction of the model through revised Petri net modeling. Revised Petri net is a proposed method based on conventional Petri net model.

articleTitle: Proposal and implementation of a novel scheme for image and emotion recognition using Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The digital media especially social media is very popular in recent time. Due to which we have more number of videos than before. These videos are generally not tagged and classified. This paper aims for parallel video processing in Hadoop for fast processing and automatic tag emotions. This system recognizes face and tag emotions automatically on hadoop clusters for fast and efficient performance. This will make human work easier in classification of videos and processing on parallel system make it quick.

articleTitle: Comparative survey analysis on interleaving techniques in IDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: IDMA is new proposed multiple access technique in present and future generation mobile communication system. IDMA introduces interleaving technique along with spreading process in user specific separation. There are various interleaving procedure implemented in interleaving process. Interleaving technique produces increased correlation among the user as increase in number of users in the channel. In our work we introduce, discuss and compare different kinds of Interleaver involved in interleave division multiple access.

articleTitle: Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation Framework (FDHTAF) for web based or cloud based application testing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation Framework (FDHTAF) is a concept where taking advantage of combination of Feature driven automation framework and Hybrid automaton framework. And bundled to together new concept of Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation frame work, here business objective is divided as features and features are defined by set of keywords and corresponding test data, Test Automation Framework will use excel files to maintain test cases and test data, Property file for storing the test environment details. Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation Framework provides the user with various benefits that helps them to develop, execute and report the automation test scripts efficiently. Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation is more robust framework that has capability to convert manual test cases to automated test cases and It avoid separation of manual test cases and automation test cases. Framework is completely independent to Application Under Test (AUT) for any web based or cloud based application. Framework implementation followed various guidelines, coding standards, innovative concepts, formal processes, industrial practices, structured hierarchies, functional modularity, advanced reporting mechanism, standard way of test data representation etc. Architecture is key factor of automation design., The framework provides cost effective solution for different types testing objectives, Repeatable test conditions and reusability Reduce redundancy, speed up the testing process, Improve quality and test coverage, Reduce manual intervention and Easy reporting.

Author Keywords: Feature Driven Hybrid Test Automation Framework

articleTitle: Comparative study and performance analysis of incentive compatible routing protocol for two-hop delay tolerant networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Many routing protocols try to identify the complete route from source to destination first and then transfer the data. Sometimes, identifying the instantaneous end-to-end paths may be difficult. In such cases, the routing protocols must take a store-carry-forward approach. Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs) are such networks which uses the store-carry-forward approach in order to address the issue of lack of continuous network connectivity which is the most common problem in heterogeneous networks. Routing is the major issue for DTNs describing their overall performance. Many flooding and forwarding based routing protocols came into existence and showed their performance by considering different aspects like buffer size of the node, bandwidth, delivery probability, number of hops and energy consumption. In our work, the performance of Incentive Compatible Routing Protocol for two-hop delay tolerant networks is evaluated and compared with the performance of Epidemic Routing Protocol by considering the parameters like: Energy Balancing Factor, Routing overhead, Residual energy, Network Life time ratio, Number of alive and dead nodes and End-to-end delay.

articleTitle: An innovative research on augmented reality to control status of physical light using MAYA as part of IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This article deals with a model to control physical light status through a virtual model using MAYA and it is part of Internet of Things. Usually, the Internet of Things (IoT) is the network of physical objects - devices, vehicles, buildings and other items embedded with electronics, software, sensors, and network connectivity - that enables these objects to collect and exchange data. The Internet of Things (IoT) causes some technical issues that need to be addressed. Here we have challenged with augmented reality through IoT. Augmented reality (AR) is a live direct or indirect view of a physical, real-world environment whose elements are augmented (or supplemented) by computer-generated sensory input such as graphics or GPS data.

articleTitle: Prime distance graphs and applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Stimulated by the famous coloring task of R × R Eggleton coined the term distance graph and studied widely the prime distance graphs. A prime distance graph (PDG) G(Z, D) is one whose vertex set V is Z and the distance set D consists of a set of prime numbers. The edge set E(G) = {(u, v): u, ν ϵ V(G)}. It is characterized by the property that d(u, v) ϵ D where d(u, v) is the absolute difference of u and v. In this paper we prove certain existence and non-existence results concerning PDGs. We also discuss certain applications besides raising some open problems.

articleTitle: Enhancement of coverage in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network comprises of many sensor nodes which examine the changes in environment. Random and deterministic are the two different strategies used for deployment and enhancement of coverage of sensor nodes in wireless sensor network. Random Deployment strategy deploys nodes in random positions and deterministic deployment strategy deploys nodes in predetermined positions. The random deployment of sensor nodes, in area of interest, might lead to coverage gaps in network. One of the solutions to improve area coverage and connectivity after preliminary deployment is by mobility of sensor nodes. Coverage indicates, how efficiently the region is observed. The performance of various random deployment techniques which are used to enhance coverage of area by nodes is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of isolated and non-isolated quasi impedance source converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The impedance source converters are becoming popular in ac-dc, dc-dc, ac-ac and dc-ac power conversion. Different designing methods among these impedance network are used for the construction of impedance source network, in which quasi impedance source network is very popular. The quasi-impedance source network is designed with the different component arrangement of the conventional impedance source network. In this paper, the comparative analysis of isolated and non-isolated quasi-impedance source AC-AC converter is presented. Both topologies contain all the merits of the conventional impedance source AC-AC Converter as well as additional benefits. MATLAB simulation result of both the techniques are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Coordinated control of SVC and TCSC for voltage profile improvement employing particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Flexible AC transmission system (FACTS) devices are widely used in power system. They have characteristics to perform faster and can solve many problems in power system study. With regards to this, a particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied so that to design the coordinated parameters of static VAR compensator (SVC) and Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor (TCSC) is presented here. With behavioral nonlinearities of the power system, linear methods cannot be used to design coordinated parameters of controllers. Simulations has been done on IEEE (WSCC) 9 bus power system in MATLAB and its toolboxes. The results are compared and found that coordination of FACTS devices with each other confirm the efficiency of the proposed method for improving the voltage profile. When function of TCSC is impelled by some curb, adjustable SVC can supply additional support to upgrade the gross performance.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of bridgeless DCM SEPIC rectifier for universal input voltage applications with fast dynamic response
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper analyzes the operation of a bridgeless SEPIC rectifier for universal input voltage applications. Compared to conventional full bridge topology, the proposed SEPIC rectifier provides lower conduction losses and heating due to absence of input bridge rectifier and presence of single switching device in each half cycle. The topology is designed in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) to achieve almost unity power factor and low THD of input current. The DCM operation provides zero current turn on for power switches and simple control circuitry. The small signal modelling is done for universal line voltage range. Further, the comparative study for open loop and close loop is analyzed.

articleTitle: Servodrive based automation of 2-way boring machine using PLC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper deals with the automatic control of special purpose machine (SPM) named 2-way boring machine which is controlled using PLC and Servo drives. The machine is designed to provide fine finish to the holes present in the engine body through boring process. The manual control of the same would result in expanded time and poor accuracy which is now being solved using automation. In order to have reduced machining time two servo drives are located on either side of the machine. The movement of material to feed the cutting tool is carried out by the sliding axis which is controlled by the servo drives and sequenced according to the program developed in PLC. This paper significantly reduces time of operation with increased accuracy and maintains precise dimensions of the product. HMI is used for interfacing between human and machine.
